catalog.construction: Before BASE,validate the locally materialized codec,dedicated,ignored,registry,builder,manifest,candidate,binding and provenance specifications. Before either P06 run,P00 fixes the one stage-CAS root profile and publishes the exact immutable builder and canonical source manifest under the existing authorized-writer lock,then reopens and completely validates both. Each P06 obtains those same objects only through read-only CAS lookup with positive CAS_SIZE,complete read,EOF and rehash,runs the builder over the exhaustive source/site/form manifest,and emits results outside the CAS; observations only cross-check. After each fresh child joins,the controller constructs its typed inline attestation and candidate,and P00 validates and publishes that exact candidate under the same profile. Only after both candidate publications may independent review require normalized byte identity and ACCEPT the binding; then populate one complete literal registry and v8 catalog,rehash every definition/catalog foreign key and embed complete provenance. Until then authority0 and runtime fail closed. Runtime never learns/reclassifies a row. No value below this effective catalog dereferences the historical Round8 review mirror.

dedicated_projection_registry_spec.rule: Rows are unique and sorted by event_name,emitter,arity. Each python_type_vectors array is nonempty and unique by canonical bytes. For each listed vector there is exactly one eight-key dedicated-mapped definition whose singular python_type_vector byte-equals that member and whose other fields equal the row/materialized contract; no extra definition/vector is legal. projection_contract_sha256 hashes the exact complete object at contract_pointer canonical bytes plus LF and is never learned at runtime. Row emitter is static source provenance only. Runtime matches event,arity and exact member type-vector without emitter; two dedicated rows may not collide on that observable tuple.

acceptance_binding_spec.rule: cas_root_profile_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the one complete P00-fixed temporac.stage-input-cas-root-profile.v6 canonical object+LF that is subsequently embedded byte-for-byte in the dispatch-table authority context. Before either P06 run,P00 publishes and revalidates the complete immutable builder and canonical source manifest under that profile; every P06 builder/manifest lookup is read-only and proves positive CAS_SIZE,complete read,EOF and rehash. After each child joins,the controller constructs the inline attestation and candidate outside the CAS and P00 publishes that exact candidate; independent review begins only after both candidate carriers revalidate under the same profile. candidate_carriers is exactly sorted ordinals0,1. Each row has positive bytes equal CAS_SIZE of its independently authorized lowercase sha256 after complete read+EOF+rehash; parsed schema is the candidate schema and outer run_ordinal equals candidate.run_ordinal and embedded attestation.run_ordinal. Attestation digest/preimage/FKs validate and the two PID/starttime pairs differ. Raw candidate digests and attestations differ,but after deleting exactly run_ordinal,run_attestation and run_attestation_sha256 the candidates are byte-identical. status=ACCEPT is valid only after independent fresh review binds both carriers,builder,manifest,registry,payload and exact CAS profile. These P00 publication epochs are operations of the existing authorized writer,not new dispatch owners,receipts or DAG edges. No authority exists before this binding.

builder_artifact_spec.rule: builder_bytes and builder_sha256 identify the complete immutable builder source named by the source manifest. Before either P06 run,P00 publishes and revalidates that builder under the fixed CAS root profile whose digest is later copied byte-identically into the acceptance binding. Each P06 resolves it only by read-only CAS lookup; builder_bytes is positive and equals CAS_SIZE after complete read+EOF+rehash. Hash,count,source,profile,publication-order mismatch or alternate entrypoint fails.

candidate_spec.rule: After each P06 builder child joins,the nonauthority controller constructs this complete candidate outside the CAS. run_attestation has exactly the accepted attestation schema,rehashes to run_attestation_sha256 and matches candidate run ordinal,builder,manifest,registry and payload digests. catalog_payload is the final v8 catalog after deleting only argument_definition_provenance,argument_definition_provenance_sha256 and schema; bytes/hex/hash cover that exact eight-key canonical projection. registry_sha256 resolves the complete v7 registry. Candidate output cannot name the later acceptance binding or final catalog hash. P00 validates and publishes the exact candidate under the pre-fixed profile only after its corresponding joined run; independent review cannot select that carrier before publication and complete revalidation. P06 never writes the stage CAS.

definition_builder_spec.cas_profile_binding_rule: Before either P06 run,P00 fixes one complete CAS root profile,acquires the existing root-inode authorized-writer lock,and publishes the exact immutable builder and canonical source manifest with the authorized P00 publication algorithm. P00 closes,reopens and completely validates both objects; only then may either P06 start. Each P06 resolves those same independently authorized digests through read-only CAS lookup and proves positive CAS_SIZE,complete read,EOF and SHA-256 before executing; it emits result bytes outside the CAS and never obtains a CAS writer FD. After each P06 child joins and the controller constructs its typed inline attestation and candidate,P00 validates that candidate and attestation,reacquires the same lock and publishes that exact candidate. Independent review starts only after both candidate publications complete and rehash. The later dispatch context embeds the byte-identical profile and digest. These pre-run and post-run P00 publication epochs add no dispatch owner,receipt or DAG edge. P06 is never an authorized CAS writer; no alternate root or profile handoff exists.
construction_order: Before either run P00 publishes the immutable builder and source manifest. Each P06 statically scans all bound source sites,groups them by observable K=(event_name,arity,exact type vector) across emitter values,and proves exhaustive site/source/span provenance without observed-event discovery.

For each K coalesce cross-emitter sites only when all seven non-emitter definition fields and all expanded stage/action/token outcomes are byte-identical and nonconflicting. Serialize emitter from the least numeric site_ordinal as static provenance; conflicting sites fail before candidate creation. Fresh observations only compare bytes and never choose an emitter/form.
Resolve only the closed codec universe or four dedicated projection rows; any unsupported exact type/form requires a new reviewed amendment and fails closed.

For run_ordinal0 and run_ordinal1,one fresh P06 child uses only the prepublished read-only inputs to construct the complete registry and eight-key catalog payload,canonicalize/hash and exit; the controller joins it and constructs the typed attestation and candidate outside the CAS. P00 validates and publishes that exact candidate under the pre-fixed profile and existing authorized-writer lock only after the corresponding run. Only after both published carriers revalidate and normalize byte-identically may the independent acceptance binding populate final provenance/catalog and BASE.

run_attestation_spec.digest_rule: run_attestation_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete standalone eleven-key canonical attestation plus LF and is absent from that object.
run_attestation_spec.rule: The nonauthority preflight controller constructs this object only after one fresh child process terminates. run_ordinal is0 or1; child_pid and starttime are positive and the pair differs across runs; exit_code=0,wait_status_u32=0,status=JOINED_PASS. Builder,manifest,registry and catalog-payload digests exactly equal the enclosing candidate values. It contains no candidate digest or candidate bytes, so the edge run inputs/results -> attestation -> candidate is acyclic. Missing wait,process reuse,digest mismatch or fabricated freshness fails.

source_manifest_spec.digest_binding_rule: Rows are in exact field order codec,dedicated,ignored,import plan and have exactly digest_binding_row_closed_keys. The first three manifest fields equal their nonnull literal expected_static_sha256_or_null and a fresh canonical-LF hash of the exact local pointer value. import_plan_sha256 is nonnull in the actual manifest and equals the existing BASE role future artifact digest under that pointer digest_rule; its expected_static value is null only because its complete reviewed rows are future-populated before BASE, not runtime-learned. Pointer mismatch,hashing a parent/wrapper or substituting a mirror fails.
source_manifest_spec.form_definition_digest_rule: Every form row definition is an exact closed eight-key definition. definition_sha256 is SHA-256 of that standalone canonical definition bytes plus LF; it must select the byte-identical unique final registry definition and every catalog_outcome must select a catalog row carrying the same digest. A digest over a wrapper,old seven-key projection or alternate equivalent definition fails. The emitter field is the deterministic least-site representative; runtime selection uses K without emitter before recomputing this static eight-key digest.
source_manifest_spec.observable_key_rule: Group every source site by K=(event_name,arity,exact python_type_vector) across emitter values. A group yields exactly one form only when its seven non-emitter definition fields and complete expanded outcomes are byte-identical/nonconflicting. The form definition.emitter equals the emitter of the least numeric site_ordinal in that group; site_ordinals retain the complete emitter set. Runtime never uses that representative. Conflict,second definition for K or outcome collision fails.
source_manifest_spec.outcome_sort_rule: Within each form, catalog_outcomes is nonempty,duplicate-free and totally sorted by action UTF-8 bytes,mapped_token_or_null with null before string,then complete canonical stage_set array bytes. Every stage_set obeys the exact catalog stage vocabulary. The expanded (definition digest,stage,action,token) keys are unique across all forms. Expanded uniqueness is keyed by observable K,stage,action,token across all emitter metadata.
source_manifest_spec.rule: source_rows are the complete accepted CPython3.12.13/native supervisor/initialization/import/finalization emitter sources and sole builder source. Every source path is unique; source_rows are strictly sorted by complete path UTF-8 bytes; bytes equals the exact complete byte length at that accepted path and sha256 hashes those exact complete bytes. site_rows are strictly sorted by numeric site_ordinal,whose values are unique,zero-based and gap-free. Every site source_path selects exactly one source row and source_sha256 equals that row sha256; each span is half-open with 0<=span_start_byte<span_end_byte<=source.bytes and span_sha256 hashes exactly source_bytes[span_start_byte:span_end_byte]. Every literal emit site appears exactly once. form_rows are strictly sorted by numeric form_ordinal,whose values are unique,zero-based and gap-free. Each site_ordinals array is numeric-ascending and duplicate-free,every value selects exactly one site row,and the multiset union of all form site_ordinals is an exact no-omission,no-duplication partition of every site_ordinal. Form rows contain complete definitions/outcomes and are derived solely from those sites and the fixed import plan; observations cannot widen them. All four top digest fields obey digest_binding_rows,and every form definition/hash/catalog FK obeys form_definition_digest_rule. Form grouping and representative emitter obey observable_key_rule; an emitter is never inferred from a runtime callback.

catalog.digest_rule: The complete eleven-key future catalog is canonical JSON+LF; its external digest is the existing audit-event-policy-catalog BASE role digest. Registry and provenance hashes cover their complete standalone canonical values including LF. Every row's definition digest covers the complete eight-key definition and every embedded spec/value rehashes; no self digest or catalog-to-candidate backedge is present.

ignored_projection_spec.rule: arguments is the exact positional array. Every element is encoded only by the definition's recursive closed codec spec, has the exact tag literal from the codec registry, and round-trips to the exact source type/value. Missing,extra,reordered,cross-definition,non-NFC,noncanonical integer,float payload,subclass or unsupported type fails.

kernel_transition_constant_ledger_spec.clone_recipe_rule: temporac.allowed-pthread-clone-recipe.v5 has a nonempty gap-free form array populated only from two identical bound glibc/CPython3.12.13 preflights. Each form is one exact pthread clone/clone3 argument shape; exit_signal=0, required CLONE_VM|CLONE_SIGHAND|CLONE_THREAD semantics and exact optional flags are encoded in clone_flags_u64_hex. Namespace,vfork,untraced,pidfd,cgroup,set_tid and unknown/reserved forms are absent and rejected.
kernel_transition_constant_ledger_spec.digest_rules: kernel_transition_constant_ledger_sha256 hashes the complete temporac.kernel-transition-constant-ledger.v8 artifact canonical bytes plus LF. syscall_table_sha256 hashes exact temporac.linux-x86_64-syscall-table.v7 bytes plus LF. clone_recipe_sha256 hashes exact clone recipe bytes plus LF. Each syscall policy_row_sha256 hashes its exact standalone five-key syscall row plus LF. Digests are external to their own preimages.
kernel_transition_constant_ledger_spec.runtime_constant_rule: runtime_constant_required_names is the exact closed class-to-ASCII-name universe and runtime_constant_required_classes is exactly its sorted key set. Complete unique runtime_constant_rows contain exactly one bound numeric value for every listed pair and no unlisted pair. The v7 ledger additionally closes ACCESS/AT/CLOCK/DIRENT/SEEK/STATX constants and exact UAPI layout rows used by all 29 reader/query variants. P06 produces two byte-identical source-bound ledgers before policy/BASE; missing,extra,duplicate,symbol-only,host-live or cross-ABI values fail.
kernel_transition_constant_ledger_spec.signal_mask_rule: All masks use the exact accepted Linux sigset width and lowercase fixed-width hex. child_mask_hex has SIGCHLD clear and is the exact mask restored by the child after closing49. parent_mask_hex is exactly child_mask_hex bitwise-OR the singleton SIGCHLD bit and is installed before fork. signalfd_mask_hex is exactly the singleton SIGCHLD bitset, is a subset of parent_mask_hex, and is the sole mask passed to signalfd4. Any padding bit, different width, live inherited mask or extra signalfd signal fails.
kernel_transition_constant_ledger_spec.syscall_table_rule: max_syscall_number is exactly471 from the bound Linux x86_64 native table and rows cover every integer0..471 exactly once in numeric order; holes are UNASSIGNED_<decimal>. Each exact five-key row has action,args_variant,class,name,number. The complete assigned-name partition has exactly385 names:375 required rows plus10 reviewed_passthrough_rows fixed by policy; every other numeric row is a literal UNASSIGNED reject. Within required,303 names use REJECT/ENTRY_REJECT_REGS6 and72 use DECODE_AND_VALIDATE with one of the73 closed args variants. The 15 obsolete sys_ni names,seven selector-bearing former passthroughs and rseq are conservative rejects. The ten reviewed names are the exact scalar no-pointer/no-selector set and use REVIEWED_REGS6. Action,args variant,class,name and number are hashed as the complete table; no source-handler inference,runtime fallback or omitted assigned name is permitted.
kernel_transition_constant_ledger_spec.uapi_layout_rule: The future artifact has exactly one ASCII-sorted uapi_layout_rows member for every uapi_layout_required_names token and no other member. Each positive byte_size/alignment and gap-free byte-offset field table is derived twice from the bound Linux x86_64 UAPI source bytes; fields are unique,in range and nonoverlapping,and every unclaimed byte is explicit padding that must also byte-match the precommitted output. Every token in uapi_layout_expected_fixed_sizes must have that exact byte_size; LINUX_DIRENT and LINUX_DIRENT64 retain their bound variable-record header/record rules. UID/GID,capability,stat/statx,dirent/dirent64,rlimit/rlimit64,timespec/timeval,utsname,u64,int32,pid_t,kernel-signal,stack_t and robust-list-head decoding uses only these rows. Host headers,sizeof,ctypes defaults or runtime-learned padding fail.
kernel_transition_constant_ledger_spec.uapi_source_rule: Rows are unique normalized project-install-ledger paths for the exact Linux UAPI, glibc pthread, ptrace, procfs and signal sources; complete raw bytes/size/hash resolve through the BASE source/toolchain ledger. No host header, uname lookup or runtime discovery substitutes.

kernel_transition_monitor_policy_spec.architecture_values_and_resolvers: Architecture literals and syscall table digest resolve the complete accepted constant ledger. the future attach_barrier value is governed by attach_barrier_spec and signal_policy is the exact closed static value; masks,options,stub PCs and numeric values resolve ledger rows. constant_ledger_sha256 hashes the complete inline ledger, supervisor_elf_sha256 resolves the installed build output, and no unresolved symbolic authority remains.

attach_barrier_spec.future_rule: child/parent masks resolve the accepted constant-ledger signal_mask_rule. stub_pc_rows is the complete nonempty sorted set described by stub_pc_row_rule,covers exactly every stub_pc_operation_values x stub_pc_phase_values state that is reachable in the fixed stub,and is populated and independently reviewed before BASE. No null,UNASSIGNED,live-learned,caller or partial-PC row is legal.
attach_barrier_spec.stub_pc_row_rule: Rows are unique by operation,phase,numeric relative RIP and sorted in that order. For CLOSE34,PROVE34,CLOSE50,PROVE50 and READ,SETUP enumerates every reviewed userspace instruction boundary whose next syscall is that operation; ENTRY is the exact syscall-entry/in-flight boundary; EXIT is the exact post-syscall stop/return boundary. READ EXIT is not an admissible initial state before release; READ ENTRY includes the blocked read. Rows cover every fixed-stub boundary from child fork branch through read return,are nonempty and complete from reviewed disassembly,and bind one supervisor ELF digest. No unlisted gap PC,absolute/ASLR address,live-learned offset,operation/phase mismatch or duplicate is legal.

digest_rules.group_recipe: recipe_sha256 hashes the exact standalone group recipe row after deleting only recipe_sha256, canonical JSON plus LF. expected_transition_rows have exactly after_permissions_or_null,before_permissions_or_null,effect_length_bytes,file_offset_bytes_or_null,operation,provider_evidence_sha256_or_null,transition_ordinal and sort by gap-free transition_ordinal.
digest_rules.monitor_policy: kernel_transition_monitor_policy_sha256 hashes the exact complete closed policy object canonical bytes plus LF and is external to that object.
digest_rules.state: state_sha256 hashes decoded complete temporac.executable-address-state.v6 canonical bytes plus LF; state_bytes_hex decodes to those exact bytes and recanonicalizes bytewise.
digest_rules.syscall_args: syscall_args_sha256 hashes the complete per-syscall closed args object canonical bytes plus LF.

kernel_transition_monitor_policy_spec.futex_profile_rule: Each group recipe carries a literal expected_futex_cooperations array sorted by gap-free futex_profile_ordinal. Two identical P06 runs freeze only equal-value PRIVATE WAIT/WAKE pairs: group effect cursor,distinct deterministic tasks,exact commands,expected/count and identical normalized nonzero bitsets. Runtime virtual addresses are excluded from BASE; the pair requires one aligned runtime uaddr equal in both args and accepted same-mm nonexecutive writable memory. For a group cooperation group_ordinal_or_null and recipe_cursor_or_null are both nonnull: the group selects the active ENTER,recipe_cursor equals its committed effect cursor,and futex_profile_ordinal equals the current group futex cursor and selects that exact row. A group consumes profiles strictly in order and exhausts them at EXIT; null-group pairs use expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations. Nothing is learned from authority runs.
kernel_transition_monitor_policy_spec.group_recipe_rule: group_recipes are nonempty and gap-free in the frozen pre-main,CPython initialization and import-plan order. expected_transition_rows and expected_futex_cooperations may be empty. At ENTRY the exact policy,args,before states,group and committed effect/futex cursors are checked; at EXIT actual ordered effects byte-match the next expected rows and commit before userspace. Equal-value blocking FUTEX consumes exactly one static group or null-gap profile through the four-gate whole-span epoch,with the group/recipe fields both nonnull or both null as defined and futex_profile_cursor_before equal to the selected profile ordinal. Group EXIT and every phase boundary require exact effect/profile exhaustion; no effect or cooperation is learned from twins.
kernel_transition_monitor_policy_spec.policy_row_digest_rule: Every transition policy_row_sha256 hashes the unique exact five-key v6 syscall-table row canonical bytes plus LF. Its action selects exactly one closed args variant. ENTRY_TO_EXIT validates the row,args,before states and committed online prefix; EXIT_TO_USERSPACE validates complete after FD/path/address/output evidence and commits actual ordered effects before userspace. A FUTEX cooperation binds the next static group or ungrouped profile before its first resume.

signal_policy.rule: Any signal-delivery or group stop on a PASS path fails closed and is never reinjected. During controller failure cleanup only SIGKILL may be injected exactly as the cleanup algorithm states; no other child signal policy or live disposition is accepted.

entry_reject_rows: MAP_FIXED or MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE overlap with executable VMA
all unmodeled file data,metadata,xattr,sync,lock,IPC,socket,signal,timer,scheduler,resource,namespace,module,keyring and tracing mutations
any executable-range removal,move,replace or permission loss
fork,vfork,exec after the sole target exec,namespace or untraced clone

fd_path_policy.open_rule: open/openat/openat2 decode bounded NUL-terminated raw path bytes at ENTRY and reject write/read-write access,O_CREAT,O_TRUNC,O_APPEND,O_TMPFILE,unsupported flags,nonzero reserved/trailing open_how bytes or alternate-root resolution. Any successful regular/provider FD is read-only and receives a fresh OFD ordinal. Every successful path must resolve one precommitted read-only input/provider role; /proc/*/mem,magic,device,unreviewed filesystem and mutable alias opens fail even with read-only flags.
fd_path_policy.read_and_query_rule: READ/PREAD64/READV/PREADV/PREADV2 use only tracked read-only precommitted provider/input FDs or exact DEV_NULL. ENTRY fixes every destination,iovec,count,offset and flags; preadv2 requires flags0 and explicit nonnegative offset,so offset -1 rejects. EXIT before userspace captures every written byte and compares it to the provider slice. READ/READV advance shared OFD offset; PREAD variants do not. LSEEK permits only tracked seekable regular/directory FDs,SEEK_SET/CUR and a nonnegative result and atomically sets every alias offset. GETDENTS/64 parse their bound ABI records against the complete precommitted directory projection and set the shared directory cookie from EXIT evidence. ACCESS forbids W_OK; every path,dirfd,flag,metadata,credential,cwd,symlink,resource,affinity,kernel and output identity resolves an existing authority object and cannot be learned from runtime. The sole ioctl(FD6,FIONREAD) additionally binds result_pointer_u64_hex at ENTRY and a four-byte FD_QUERY output at EXIT; its u32 value is zero and cross-matches the physical-entry carrier row.
fd_path_policy.rule: The complete max471 table deterministically partitions385 assigned names into375 required and10 exact reviewed scalar register-only names. The required set partitions into303 entry rejects and72 decoded variants. decoded_fd_syscalls is the exact decoded FD/path/pointer-output subset. All direct,vectored,asynchronous,namespace,metadata,random,queue-consuming and indirect executable-byte writers not given a closed decoder reject at ENTRY. The seven selector-bearing getpgid,getpriority,getsid,ioprio_get,kcmp,sched_getscheduler and timer_getoverrun calls and rseq are literal ENTRY_REJECT_REGS6 rows; none may use REVIEWED_PASSTHROUGH or a decoded fallback. The only ioctl is exact FD6 FIONREAD. Open/dup/fcntl/close/write,all A29 reader/query calls,the conservative sys_ni rejects and every numeric tail row have one unique action/variant. Omission,extra name,wrong max or REVIEWED substitution fails before BASE.
fd_path_policy.syscall_output_contract_rule: Rows are ASCII syscall_name sorted and unique. Their33 names and the sorted39 syscall_output_none_names are disjoint and their union is exactly the72 DECODE_AND_VALIDATE names. Every row args_variant is the unique constant-ledger variant. Each destination_templates array is template_ordinal sorted and uses only an exact token in syscall_output_contract_token_grammar; ARG/EACH fields must exist in that variant,LAYOUT names must resolve one required UAPI row,and all true destinations are nonoverlapping accepted writable nonexecutive memory. At matched EXIT before userspace,result_i64 and the selected result/length/cardinality rules determine the exact destination count/order and bytes. The output kind,source digest and source offset must match the selected literal row. A none-name is permitted only when its complete allowed variant performs no tracee-memory output at that return; any UAPI-possible write makes that variant ENTRY_REJECT. Conditional zero-destination rows emit null and prove no write. Clone/clone3 use the fixed parent/child-TID flags; rseq is not in either set and rejects at ENTRY. No runtime output may select or widen a row,grammar token,layout,source or offset.
fd_path_policy.write_rule: write/writev may resume only when the before-FD-state role is FD6_FRAME_PIPE or DEV_NULL. FD6 bytes equal one exact already-framed stream write and total is <=PIPE_BUF; provider,regular/block/proc-mem or other write-capable FD fails. MAP_SHARED providers and executable mapping from a write-capable FD reject. FD6 may not be replaced,duplicated,imported or flag-mutated. It may be closed exactly once only after the child has successfully written its complete accepted terminal 0x7e or 0x7f frame and will emit no later byte: close args must name6,result0/null errno,the strict after FD-state removes6,no later transition references6,and the parent drains the complete frame then observes EOF before accepting terminal wait. Any premature/error/duplicate close or missing EOF fails. Its sole read-side FIONREAD remains the physical-entry call.

online_recipe_prefix.cursor_rule: Each group expected_transition_rows array and group/null-gap FUTEX profile array has exact gap-free ordinals. ENTER activates the next group with effect and group-futex cursors0; null gaps use the global ungrouped cursor and exact surrounding frame FKs. A cooperation requires the group/recipe selectors both nonnull or both null,profile ordinal equal to the selected current cursor,and after=before+1 only at atomic G3. At a returning EXIT while all tasks remain stopped,flatten actual effects in the fixed order and byte-compare every row with the next expected prefix before committing. Underflow,overflow,wrong group/order/multiplicity/provider/permissions/offset,duplicate effect or profile mismatch fails with prior cursors retained.
online_recipe_prefix.effect_sort_rule: While all tasks remain stopped flatten all effects and sort by numeric start,end,operation UTF-8,null-before-string provider,permissions and file offset. effect_length_bytes=end-start and projected transition_ordinal=cursor+i. No set-only comparison or post-resume validation is allowed.
online_recipe_prefix.expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations_ru: The future policy expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations array is globally gap-free by futex_profile_ordinal and sorted in execution order. Each row is the same static wait/wake recipe as a group profile plus exact after/before phase-frame ordinal FKs delimiting one null-group gap; post-DISPATCH uses after=DISPATCH_SEAL and before=null. A null-group cooperation consumes exactly the next row. Every ENTER,PREMAIN_SEAL,DISPATCH_SEAL and terminal boundary proves the just-ended gap exhausted. Runtime uaddr,outcome,epoch,state and K digest never enter this BASE array; two P06 runs must produce byte-identical rows,including an exact empty array when no such pair exists.
online_recipe_prefix.phase_rule: PREMAIN_SEAL and every EXIT require exact current group effect/futex exhaustion. Every ENTER,PREMAIN_SEAL,DISPATCH_SEAL and terminal boundary also proves the preceding ungrouped profile gap exhausted. DISPATCH_SEAL forbids later executable effect but may be followed only by its explicitly precommitted null-group FUTEX rows. Missing,extra,nested,misordered or unexhausted group/gap fails before userspace.
online_recipe_prefix.resume_rule: Every PTRACE_SYSCALL resume selects exactly one closed gate. ENTRY_TO_EXIT validates the five-key policy row,closed args,before FD/path/address/provider state,the exact syscall-output contract and current ordered recipe prefix,then resumes only the initiator to the matched EXIT; no unavailable after-state is fabricated at ENTRY. CLONE_EVENT_TO_EXIT retains the same reservation through the intermediate clone event. EXIT_TO_USERSPACE captures result/errno,contract-selected output destinations,after FD/OFD/path/address/provider state and ordered effects,then atomically commits state/effect/profile cursors before any userspace resume. Equal-value PRIVATE FUTEX uses the four-gate whole-span cooperation epoch and requires the stopped WAKE-entry word to differ from the wait expected value before G2; immediate mismatch EAGAIN and standalone WAKE use ordinary gates. Zero/multiple gates,wrong static group/null-gap profile or cursor,early userspace,missing release observation or unvalidated output fails while stopped.

syscall_policy.resolver_rule: allowed_clone_recipe_sha256 equals constant_ledger.clone_recipe_sha256. The complete bound max471 table has exactly385 assigned names: required_syscall_rows is exactly375 and reviewed_passthrough_rows exactly10. entry_reject_syscalls is exactly303; the other72 required rows are DECODE_AND_VALIDATE with one named variant. The 15 obsolete sys_ni names,the seven selector-bearing former passthroughs and rseq are included in the rejects. The ten reviewed rows are exactly getegid,geteuid,getgid,getpgrp,getpid,getppid,gettid,getuid,sched_get_priority_max,sched_get_priority_min; they take no pointer,FD,path or external task selector,return only through registers and use REVIEWED_REGS6. Every decoded row name,number,class,action,variant,args and policy digest cross-matches. Missing,extra,duplicate,cross-action,pointer-bearing or selector-bearing passthrough,or generic-register substitution fails.

kernel_transition_monitor_policy_spec.ungrouped_futex_profile_rule: The future policy expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations array is globally gap-free by futex_profile_ordinal and sorted in execution order. Each row is the same static wait/wake recipe as a group profile plus exact after/before phase-frame ordinal FKs delimiting one null-group gap; post-DISPATCH uses after=DISPATCH_SEAL and before=null. For a null-group cooperation group_ordinal_or_null and recipe_cursor_or_null are both null; futex_profile_ordinal equals the current global ungrouped cursor and the row's frame FKs exactly bracket the current gap. Every ENTER,PREMAIN_SEAL,DISPATCH_SEAL and terminal boundary proves the just-ended gap exhausted. Runtime uaddr,outcome,epoch,state and K digest never enter this BASE array; two P06 runs must produce byte-identical rows,including an exact empty array when no such pair exists.

rules: action is exactly map,ignored-nonexecutive,or reject. emitter is one static provenance representative from CPYTHON,NATIVE_SUPERVISOR,INITIALIZATION,IMPORT,FINALIZATION and is never a runtime selector. action=map requires one preserved token; ignored/reject requires null. arg_projection_schema and definition digest satisfy the unique observable definition selected without emitter.

Rows serialize in total order by event_name,numeric arity,arg_projection_schema,static emitter,arg_projection_definition_sha256,action,mapped_token null-before-string,then canonical stage_set bytes. stage_set is a nonempty sorted unique subset of the exact child-only stage vocabulary. Static emitter is only a deterministic tie-breaker after observable-key uniqueness and never callback authority.

At the callback the observable definition key K=(event_name,positional arity,exact Python type vector) selects exactly one definition while ignoring emitter. The frozen state machine then selects exactly one expanded outcome by (K,current stage,action,mapped token),also ignoring emitter. Only after unique selection may the verifier read the row's static representative emitter and recompute the eight-key definition digest. Raw evidence supplies no emitter,site,PC,stage or outcome. Zero/multiple K definitions or outcomes,emitter-based selection,wildcard,prefix or runtime-learned row fails.

Every ignored-nonexecutive event/site/form is explicitly and exhaustively enumerated by the accepted source manifest and has a codec-fields definition bound to temporac.audit-args.ignored.v6. Ordinary artifact/data/receipt/index open or mmap is ignored only when that exact row says so and its bytes never become executable.

code.__new__,function.__new__,marshal or pickle code loading,sys.addaudithook after native installation,sys.settrace,sys.setprofile,subinterpreters,Python process spawning,executable anonymous memory and unexpected ctypes.dlsym or ctypes.call_function are explicit reject outcomes. Missing reject rows or converting reject to ignored/map fails.

Each catalog row references one definition; every definition has at least one row. Builder grouping across emitters guarantees exactly one definition for each observable K and unique expanded outcomes by K,stage,action,token. Compatible sites coalesce with the least-site-ordinal emitter as static representative; conflicting cross-emitter definitions/outcomes fail before candidate creation. Catalog/form/source sorts and all site provenance remain independently rederived.
catalog.stage_token_vocabulary_rule: The materialized array byte-equals the exact pointer value, has 33 unique nonempty ASCII tokens in child execution order and hashes as canonical array+LF to stage_token_vocabulary_sha256. Every catalog stage_set is a nonempty ASCII-byte-sorted unique subset; no controller/local-overlay/safe-barrier prose token,alias or runtime-discovered stage is accepted.

bool.value: value is exact JSON true or false

bytes.value: bytes is a nonnegative integer; hex is lowercase even-length and decodes to exactly that many bytes

code.value: projection is one recursively valid code-object-projection.v5 object; projection_sha256 hashes its standalone canonical bytes plus LF; nesting is finite and pointer-cycle-free

complex-binary64.value: each bits field is exactly sixteen lowercase hex digits of the corresponding IEEE-754 binary64 storage bits in network byte order; every NaN payload, infinity and signed zero is preserved

float-binary64.value: bits_be_hex is exactly sixteen lowercase hex digits of IEEE-754 binary64 storage bits in network byte order; every NaN payload, infinity and signed zero is preserved

frozenset.value: items contains each recursively encoded element exactly once, ordered by its complete canonical variant bytes without terminal LF; duplicate encoded bytes or digest-only ordering fails

int.value: decimal is exactly 0 or -?[1-9][0-9]* and denotes the unbounded Python integer; plus, leading zero and negative zero are forbidden

null.value: tag is null and represents Python None

str.value: value is the exact Python Unicode scalar sequence; lone surrogate and alternate normalization are rejected and canonical JSON encodes the unchanged string

tuple.value: items preserves exact tuple order and contains recursively encoded variants

code_object_projection.hash_rule: code_authority_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical projection bytes including exactly one LF. For code_hex, linetable_hex and exceptiontable_hex, the paired byte count is nonnegative and lowercase hex decodes to exactly that many CPython bytes. argcount,posonlyargcount,kwonlyargcount,nlocals,stacksize,firstlineno are JSON integers in [0,2147483647]; flags is in [0,4294967295]. filename,name,qualname and every names/varnames/freevars/cellvars element are exact Unicode scalar strings; the four arrays preserve CPython tuple order. consts preserves co_consts order. Unsupported constant type, mutable value, recursive pointer cycle, missing/extra field, alternate endian or alternate tag fails.
code_object_projection.tag_rule: Each constant is exactly one object whose tag is the literal variant key above and whose keys equal that variant's closed_keys. No JSON primitive directly represents a constant, no variant omits its tag, and no extra value/count/digest field is permitted.
code_object_projection.variant_selection: Select by exact CPython object identity/type, not isinstance: None, Ellipsis and NotImplemented use only their exact singletons; type(x) is bool,int,float,complex,bytes,str,tuple or frozenset selects the same-named variant; PyCode_CheckExact selects code. Bool is therefore never int. Subclasses, bytearray, memoryview, list, mutable container and every other type fail. Tuple/frozenset recursion applies this same rule at every element and detects repeated in-progress object identity before descent.

delta.digest_rule: dynamic_mapping_delta_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical delta bytes including LF and is absent from the object. Each bytes value is positive; lowercase hex decodes to exactly the complete canonical mapping-set bytes including LF and the paired digest hashes them. load_group_ordinal is a nonnegative gap-free import-barrier group number. raw_parent_sequences is a nonempty strictly increasing integer array and primary_elf_sha256s is an equal-length array of exact ELF digests; their positions bind every successful primary PY_EXTENSION_LOAD or CTYPES_DLOPEN occurrence in the group.
delta.rule: A group is exactly one of two supervisor-owned boundaries. For owner_kind=cpython-initialization, before is the already emitted initial-preinitialize mapping set and after is captured immediately after Py_InitializeFromConfig returns. For owner_kind=top-level-import, the supervisor captures before immediately before one exact fixed-plan PyImport_ImportModule call and after only when that call returns to the same C loop. This grouped safe barrier deliberately claims no nonexistent post-dlopen callback. The group's raw_parent_sequences/primary_elf_sha256s equal the exact future-precommitted expected_dynamic_load_groups row and include every nested extension/ctypes primary completed during that boundary; search mirrors are excluded. after contains every before row byte-for-byte with identical multiplicity, including kernel rows. new_rows is exact multiset difference in after order, only kind=file-elf, and may be empty only when every primary ELF was already in before. Every primary is in after; every new nonprimary row is reachable by a finite exact DT_NEEDED edge path from at least one listed primary. Shared dependency stays one collective row and is never guessed onto one caller. Removal, kernel change, identity/segment drift, raw/group mismatch, unrelated ELF, missing dependency, basename substitution, digest-only set or unmapped primary fails.

dynamic_mapping_closure.extension_group_rule: For one logical extension import, exactly resolved-provider occurrence is primary: primary raw sequence equals its raw reference, load-group ordinal identifies enclosing initialization or top-level-import barrier, and delta digest is present. Stock earlier search occurrence is mirror: same extension,later primary sequence,group ordinal,null delta. Both buffer until post-initialize or PyImport-return barrier, then normalize by raw sequence; mirror never enters primary arrays. Every extension/ctypes primary in same boundary repeats one collective digest and arrays list each once. Exactly one primary+earlier mirror exist when stock emits both; single primary only when accepted CPython path emits no search occurrence. Cross-module mirror,missing group,inconsistent digest or unlisted raw fails. No per-extension post-return interposition/dependency attribution is asserted.

kernel_runtime_evidence.digest_rule: kernel_runtime_evidence_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical twelve-key bytes including LF and is absent from the object. Every kernel-exec provider_evidence_sha256 is exactly this digest; no ten-key projection, field omission or self-zeroing preimage is accepted.
kernel_runtime_evidence.rule: This future-populated P00 artifact is reviewed before BASE and binds the exact x86_64 Linux kernel image retrievable bytes/hash/build-id/release plus the exact in-memory [vdso] executable mapping bytes/hash for that runtime. architecture=x86_64; counts are positive; hashes are lowercase over complete bytes. vsyscall_start_address_u64_hex is exactly 0xffffffffff600000 and vsyscall_end_address_u64_hex exactly 0xffffffffff601000. vsyscall_mode is none,emulate,or native and must equal boot/kernel readback; none forbids the row, emulate/native require exactly that 4096-byte --xp interval. It contains no launch/run/evidence output. The child rehashes [vdso] bytes at initial and terminal capture; [vsyscall] is not read when permissions deny access and is authorized only by exact mode/range plus this complete evidence digest. Kernel/image/vdso/range mismatch,alternate boot,unreadable required VDSO or fabricated hash fails before child authority.

mapping_evidence.row_rule: Rows are exact child-frame order and frame_sequence is gap-free. kind=mapping-set requires type0x12, group ordinal null and stage initial-preinitialize or terminal-after-finalize; payload is exact mapping_set bytes. kind=mapping-delta requires type0x13, nonnegative gap-free group ordinal and dynamic-after; payload is exact grouped delta with same ordinal, and every listed primary origin repeats payload_sha256/group while mirrors repeat ordinal but null digest. Counts/hex/hash bind complete payload including LF. Initial is first,terminal last, and interior rows are bijective in order with complete expected_dynamic_load_groups: at most first is cpython-initialization, all remaining are top-level-import. No per-loader,mirror-owned or unframed delta exists.

mapping_set.digest_rule: executable_mapping_set_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical mapping-set bytes including LF and is absent from the object.
mapping_set.row_rule: Each row is discriminated by kind. kind=file-elf requires exactly file_row_closed_keys: absolute_path is normalized from the exact /proc/self/maps pathname after rejecting deleted, memfd, bracket, relative, symlink-race or ambiguous paths; device/inode are exact nonnegative integers and byte-equal fstat; ELF bytes/build-id/DT_NEEDED/provider_class resolve one precommitted ELF row; provider_evidence_kind is cpython-runtime-member,installed-member,native-build-output,native-install-member,initial-native-image,or system-runtime-elf and its digest resolves that exact typed row, never a basename. kind=kernel-exec requires exactly kernel_row_closed_keys: mapping_name is [vdso] or [vsyscall], provider_evidence_sha256 resolves the exact BASE kernel-runtime-evidence; [vdso] has permissions=r-xp, positive mapped_bytes equal vdso_bytes and nonnull exact in-memory hash, while [vsyscall] has permissions=--xp, mapped_bytes exactly 4096, null hash and is present iff vsyscall_mode is emulate or native. No other bracket/anonymous executable mapping exists. File executable_segments are nonempty and match maps+dl_iterate; mapping_ordinal is zero-based among identical identities. Kernel rows occur first in mapping_name byte order, then file rows by UTF-8 absolute_path,device_major,device_minor,inode,mapping_ordinal; all rows are unique.
mapping_set.segment_rule: File segments are positive mapped_bytes, nonnegative page-aligned file_offset_bytes, exact permissions r-xp or --xp, and ordered by file offset then permissions then length. The set is captured by one `/proc/self/maps` open/read/EOF plus one dl_iterate_phdr traversal with exact path/inode/load-segment reconciliation; kernel rows are reconciled separately to kernel-runtime-evidence. Transient capture descriptors are opened only at the specified safe barrier, closed and proved EBADF. Address/ASLR values are verified for reconciliation but deliberately absent from canonical bytes.

dynamic_mapping_closure.terminal_rule: The child emits exact 0x12 initial-preinitialize bytes after PREMAIN_SEAL and exact 0x12 terminal-after-finalize bytes after successful Py_FinalizeEx. Every initialization/import group emits 0x14 ENTER/EXIT, but exactly one existing 0x13 delta is emitted if and only if its precommitted monitor group recipe has nonnull dynamic_load_group_ordinal_or_null; null groups emit no 0x13. Every nonnull ordinal uniquely selects one nonempty-primary expected_dynamic_load_group, and a legitimate zero-new-row delta is still serialized. Apply only those deltas in gap-free dynamic ordinal order to the initial multiset; each before projection equals current after changing only stage, and the resulting terminal projection byte-equals the independent capture. The parent address-state projection and transition effects must independently reconstruct the same 0x12/0x13 bytes. DISPATCH_SEAL precedes dispatch and every later executable change fails. No extra token/origin, anonymous/JIT mapping, kernel-row change or executable unload is accepted.

event_order.controller_reserved_sequence: For each child process_ordinal, the controller reserves normalized sequence 0 from the exact fork launch/request but does not claim exec success from fork return or an undefined handshake. Only after it validates the child's unique PROCESS_IMAGE row, exact supervisor ELF/AT_EXECFN identity, terminal EOF and waitpid exit zero does it construct exactly one PROCESS_EXEC row and prepend it at reserved sequence 0 during final evidence assembly. This row is absent from the child stream; execve failure or missing/mismatched child identity creates no PASS row.
event_order.discovery_boundary: Each discovery child has no DISPATCH_BEGIN. After all pre-dispatch imports, the complete trusted-candidate prefix and config/FD/native evidence, it emits the unique discovery output, executes Py_FinalizeEx while recording every remaining raw catalog event and any mapped normalized event, then emits terminal success and EOF. Generated or other executable-origin events during finalization fail; cataloged ignored-nonexecutive shutdown events remain exact raw evidence. Generated rows remain evidence-only.
event_order.full_boundary: The full child consumes the complete trusted sequence, then emits exactly one DISPATCH_BEGIN before dereferencing the invocation input index or calling Python dispatch. Every executable/import/native origin needed by every handler must already be loaded by the complete pre-dispatch plan. After this boundary generated compile/exec, import, source compile/exec audit, ctypes load, process spawn and any new executable mapping each have exact multiplicity zero, including during Py_FinalizeEx; any occurrence fails. Cataloged ignored-nonexecutive shutdown events are still emitted as raw rows between the unique dispatch-result frame and terminal success.
event_order.per_process_sequence: Child normalized sequence begins at 1 because sequence 0 is reserved. The completed carrier-validated-and-closed NATIVE_FD_READBACK is exactly sequence 1 because launch identity is unavailable before that transport boundary. PROCESS_IMAGE follows exactly, then PREINIT_NATIVE_IMAGE rows appear in initial-native-image-index order after a closed temporary maps/exe read and before Py_PreInitialize. Post-carrier-exec-entry and locked-pre-cpython NATIVE_FD_READBACK rows follow in that order; post-pyinitialize NATIVE_FD_READBACK and CPYTHON_CONFIG_READBACK follow initialization; raw-import/compile/exec/dlopen normalized events then follow actual safe-barrier completion order. The final controller-assembled array is ordered by process_ordinal then sequence, unique and gap-free. Raw audit sequence is an independent zero-based gap-free counter referenced by raw_event_sequence_or_null.
event_order.serialization_rule: Carrier/process/preinit/native-FD rows and the initial mapping set are emitted directly in the exact early success order before hook installation. Only callback-derived raw/mapping/normalized payloads occurring before the fixed configuration frame follow audit_buffer: raw/normalized semantic sequence is fixed at event/completion time, but child-frame sequence is assigned at the one post-0x05 flush. After that flush rows are framed directly. Committed semantic sequence remains actual completed-evidence order independent of this explicitly deferred wire emission. Every transient fd used to read process maps/exe is opened only after the physical FD7 scan/close, closed and proved EBADF before the next operational readback. The controller verifies exact reserved-row plus child-row continuity and never renumbers or rewrites child bytes. Missing, extra, duplicate, gap, overflow, reordered semantic capture, conflicting raw reference or child-supplied PROCESS_EXEC fails.

event_semantics.CPYTHON_CONFIG_READBACK: Exactly one runtime-readback origin after successful Py_InitializeFromConfig and post-pyinitialize FD readback; it binds complete initialization profile, launch, config/global/sys/stream bytes and hash.
event_semantics.CTYPES_DLOPEN: One ctypes-dynamic-load origin for each successful permitted ctypes.dlopen, normalized only at its safe barrier after exact requested primary path and complete before/after executable-mapping delta resolution. The delta contains the primary plus every newly mapped DT_NEEDED/transitive ELF and no unrelated mapping. Failed, empty, uncommitted or partially mapped loads reject.
event_semantics.DISPATCH_BEGIN: Exactly one in full-runtime and zero in discovery; dispatch-boundary origin binds exact owner and source allowlist. It occurs after all required imports/trusted rows and before input-index dereference.
event_semantics.NATIVE_FD_READBACK: Exactly four per child in carrier-validated-and-closed, post-carrier-exec-entry, locked-pre-cpython, post-pyinitialize order. Each runtime-readback origin binds the complete carrier or operational readback bytes/hash, launch and applicable transport/fd profile.
event_semantics.PREINIT_NATIVE_IMAGE: Exactly one row for every row of the precommitted initial-native-image-index, in that index order, using process-image for the supervisor image and native-image for every other mapped ELF. The captured map precedes Py_PreInitialize.
event_semantics.PROCESS_EXEC: Exactly one controller-created sequence-zero process-image row per successful child, binding controller request, exact supervisor ELF and that child launch. It is finalized only after the matching child PROCESS_IMAGE plus EOF/waitpid PASS prove exec and is then prepended during controller assembly; no child emits it and no exec failure receives it.
event_semantics.PROCESS_IMAGE: Exactly one child-created process-image row immediately after the completed carrier-readback row, binding /proc/self/exe, AT_EXECFN, installed supervisor/ELF, controller request and launch byte-for-byte.
event_semantics.PY_BUILTIN_IMPORT: cpython-core origin with provider_kind=builtin and safe-barrier-resolved module/spec equality.
event_semantics.PY_CODE_EVAL: Exact multiplicity zero. Stock CPython exec audit cannot distinguish eval and no event may be guessed or relabeled as this token.
event_semantics.PY_CODE_EXEC: File-backed cpython-core/cpython-stdlib/project-installed/installed-wheel origin matching the exact code-object and source authority. Trusted generated exec is forbidden here and uses its dedicated token.
event_semantics.PY_EXTENSION_LOAD: cpython-extension,installed-extension or native-build-extension origin resolved at its initialization/import group barrier through exact runtime/association/native-install/ELF membership; _fp_control is only native-build-extension. Exactly one primary occurrence per logical extension repeats the complete shared group-delta digest and appears in its aligned primary array; a stock search mirror embeds no digest and points to that primary. Dependencies belong collectively to the group, not one extension.
event_semantics.PY_FROZEN_IMPORT: cpython-core origin with provider_kind=frozen and exact frozen/runtime ledger identity.
event_semantics.PY_IMPORT_SOURCE: cpython-stdlib, project-installed or installed-wheel origin with complete provider/source bytes and ledger equality, emitted only after successful import barrier.
event_semantics.PY_SOURCE_COMPILE: Same byte-identical file-backed origin as the unique pending source authority and exact raw compile projection. There is no compile-mode field.
event_semantics.PY_TRUSTED_GENERATED_COMPILE: Trusted-generated origin reconstructing the next exact discovery/trusted row. Discovery labeling is non-authoritative; full runtime must match the precommitted row before execution.
event_semantics.PY_TRUSTED_GENERATED_EXEC: Same byte-identical trusted-generated origin as the immediately preceding dedicated compile; it consumes that row exactly once. No delayed, reused or post-boundary event exists.

audit_and_trace.filter: Normalize only the 16 preserved executable/runtime tokens. Ordinary artifact, data, JSON, NPZ, NPY, receipt, index, log and result open/read/stat/enumerate/mmap events remain raw catalog evidence only and are ignored-nonexecutive unless those same bytes subsequently become executable input, in which case the missing executable transition rejects.

final_trace.assembly: The controller, only after terminal child frame, EOF and waitpid, joins child raw/normalized streams with process evidence. A child never records its own join; a join is not a seventeenth normalized event token.

child_stream_index.rule: Rows are exact process-ordinal order, one for full-runtime and two for discover-twin. bytes_hex reconstructs the complete magic-through-last-frame stream excluding EOF, sha256 hashes it, eof_observed=true, terminal_frame_sequence names the unique final 0x7e/0x7f sequence, and no child stream contains its wait result.

final_trace.kernel_transition_rule: kernel_transition_index_bytes_hex decodes to the complete published K canonical bytes plus LF and hashes to kernel_transition_index_sha256. It cross-matches the one full launch attach evidence, request,process,policy,0x14 phase frames,0x12/0x13 summaries and initial/terminal mapping sets. process_joins remains byte-identical to the earlier eight-key J rows and contains no K field, preventing J->K->trace cycles.
final_trace.mapping_evidence_rule: executable_mapping_evidence is the exact parsed temporac.executable-mapping-evidence-index.v5 projection of every 0x12/0x13 frame in child order. First/last are sole initial/terminal sets with matching trace digests. Interior deltas are gap-free and bijective with complete expected_dynamic_load_groups: at most first owner is cpython-initialization and all remaining owners are top-level-import. Each raw_parent_sequences/primary_elf_sha256s equals its precommitted group; every primary repeats group ordinal/digest, mirrors only ordinal/primary reference. No group is learned, no primary belongs to two groups, no unlisted primary exists. Ordered replay yields terminal bytes/digest equal child terminal field.

process_join_index.rule: The exact standalone index has keys child_stream_index_sha256,mode,rows,schema. rows use join_row_closed_keys in process ordinal order and are constructed only after draining each named stream to EOF and waitpid on that exact positive pid; child_starttime_ticks is the positive /proc identity captured at fork and must equal discovery/full attestation evidence, preventing PID reuse. process_join_index_sha256 hashes complete canonical index bytes including LF; no join is emitted by a child or normalized as an event.

final_trace.trace_hash_rule: final_trace_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete fifteen-key canonical trace bytes including LF. launch_evidence_index_sha256 resolves the exact one-row full-runtime launch evidence and its launch hash equals launch_instance_sha256. raw_audit_events are exact gap-free child-frame rows. normalized_events are, for each process, the controller-created PROCESS_EXEC sequence-zero row followed byte-for-byte by the child-frame rows beginning at sequence one; the merged array is process-ordinal/sequence order with no gap or rewrite. executable mapping evidence obeys mapping_evidence_rule. process_joins is exact process-ordinal order and byte-equals the separately hashed join index rows. The trace has no own hash. kernel_transition_rule is mandatory and K is published after J but before this trace; the trace does not backfill J or K.

mapping.rule: Project the five stock arguments into the exact search or resolved-provider discriminated form without repr or pointer identity. Before Py_InitializeFromConfig returns, each raw occurrence belongs to the closed expected_initialization_raw_rows prefix and remains pending until the one post-initialize safe barrier; afterward it belongs to exactly one supervisor-owned top-level PyImport call and remains pending until that call returns. At either boundary validate the complete precommitted raw/normalized projection, capture the one optional grouped mapping delta spanning that boundary, then consume/append normalized rows strictly by ascending same-process raw sequence; dependency, module, provider, path or completion sorting is forbidden. A successful sys.modules[name].__spec__ provider, normalized origin and loader resolves through exactly one BASE/FINAL ledger row, then emits exactly one PY_BUILTIN_IMPORT,PY_FROZEN_IMPORT,PY_IMPORT_SOURCE or PY_EXTENSION_LOAD. A resolved-provider occurrence may emit only PY_EXTENSION_LOAD and its filename equals that origin; search may emit any of four. For a logical extension pair, resolved-provider is primary and earlier search is mirror; both reference the same precommitted load group, only primary enters group arrays and repeats shared nonnull digest. All primaries in one initialization/import boundary share one group delta, collectively proving dependencies without per-callback post-return inference. Initialization failures are never optional; later failed imports emit no normalized row only by the next exact optional_absence row. Any occurrence outside these boundaries, failed/ambiguous/duplicate-unresolved/pre-resolution classification or post-DISPATCH_BEGIN import fails.

Arguments are source and filename only; CPython supplies no compile mode and no compile_mode may be inferred. A match to one precommitted file-backed source row emits PY_SOURCE_COMPILE. In discovery only, a non-file-backed compile with one exact source-backed Python generator frame enters the pending candidate state and is normalized as PY_TRUSTED_GENERATED_COMPILE only after its adjacent exec completes the output row; this label grants no authority. In full runtime, the same event must byte-match the next already committed trusted row before emitting PY_TRUSTED_GENERATED_COMPILE. Other compile fails.

Project the code object through its exact verified source or pending generated identity without repr, address or marshal serialization. In discovery, exactly the adjacent exec closes one pending candidate row and is then normalized as PY_TRUSTED_GENERATED_EXEC without granting authority. In full runtime, a matching pending already-committed trusted row emits PY_TRUSTED_GENERATED_EXEC; every other allowed source-backed execution emits PY_CODE_EXEC. Stock exec cannot distinguish eval, so PY_CODE_EVAL has exact multiplicity zero and is never guessed.

Record the typed requested path and raw sequence as a pending primary inside either the CPython-initialization prefix or the currently active supervisor-owned top-level import call; the stock audit event occurs before dlopen and no post-return callback is assumed. At the post-initialize barrier or when that outer PyImport call returns, resolve the exact requested ELF and consume this row at the one grouped mapping barrier. Its ctypes-dynamic-load origin repeats the precommitted load-group ordinal/shared delta digest and its own raw sequence; group arrays contain it exactly once with every extension/ctypes primary in that boundary. A ctypes.dlopen outside initialization/pre-dispatch groups, after DISPATCH_BEGIN, missing from expected_dynamic_load_groups, failed/ambiguous provider, or executable change outside the group fails.

audit_and_trace.normalized_row_hash_rule: sha256 hashes the standalone canonical six-key projection event,origin,origin_sha256,process_ordinal,raw_event_sequence_or_null,sequence plus LF. The seven-key stored row is then reconstructed by adding sha256. origin itself recanonicalizes and hashes to origin_sha256; neither digest is self-referential.
audit_and_trace.normalized_row_rule: event is exactly one event_tokens value and origin kind is allowed by origin_union.event_allowed_kinds. PROCESS_EXEC,PROCESS_IMAGE,PREINIT_NATIVE_IMAGE,NATIVE_FD_READBACK,CPYTHON_CONFIG_READBACK and DISPATCH_BEGIN are native-supervisor emissions with raw_event_sequence_or_null=null; all PY_* and CTYPES_DLOPEN normalized rows have a nonnegative raw reference resolving exactly one same-process raw row whose catalog mapping and argument projection produce this event/origin. process_ordinal and sequence obey event_order. authority_digest_projection[event][origin.kind] names the origin field whose underlying exact bytes are independently rehashed and compared; it is not the normalized row digest. sha256 only obeys normalized_row_hash_rule. A missing/extra raw link, wrong authority projection, native token from Python, or two normalized rows from one raw row fails.
audit_and_trace.normalized_row_schema: temporac.normalized-executable-event.v5 (external structural schema; the seven-key row intentionally has no schema member)

origin_union.digest_rule: origin_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact standalone kind-specific origin object serialized as canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON with one LF. The normalized row embeds that parsed object and repeats the digest. Alternate tagged-H/binary/string packing, delimiter concatenation, omitted null, renamed key, v4 schema token, path alias or digest-only origin fails.

field_equality.cpython providers: Every module/provider/runtime path and member hash equals one exact CPython runtime, builtin, frozen, source or extension ledger row; provider_kind is exactly builtin or frozen for cpython-core.
field_equality.dynamic loads: A ctypes-dynamic-load or primary extension origin's dynamic_mapping_delta_sha256 resolves exactly one type0x13 grouped mapping-evidence row with the same dynamic_mapping_load_group_ordinal. The origin's raw reference and primary ELF occur at the same position in that delta's raw_parent_sequences/primary_elf_sha256s arrays. Every primary in one group repeats the same digest; this intentional many-to-one reference does not duplicate the frame. Extension role is primary or mirror; primary has a nonnull digest and primary raw sequence equal its normalized raw reference, while mirror has null digest and points to the exact same-module primary under extension_group_rule. ctypes-dynamic-load always has one nonnull shared group digest and raw_parent_sequence equals its normalized raw reference. Every automatic dependency is represented collectively inside the group delta and terminal mapping equality; it is never silently attributed to one primary ELF.
field_equality.installed providers: association_sha256 resolves one exact sixteen-key installed-member association. distribution,version,installed_path/member hash,wheel path/member hash/wheel hash and repository path/hash where present all repeat that row byte-for-byte.
field_equality.native and process: absolute path, build-id discriminant/value, ELF hash, installed association or native-build output, launcher, controller request and launch values resolve one exact ELF/install/launch-evidence row. provider_class is exactly initial-native,installed-extension,blas,onednn,openmp,libc,libm,libstdcxx,libpython,dynamic-loader, or supervisor. The no-wheel _fp_control extension uses only native-build-extension, never installed-extension.
field_equality.runtime readback: readback_schema is exactly temporac.native-launch-carrier-readback.v5, temporac.linux-fd-readback.v5, or temporac.cpython-initialization-readback.v4; stage is allowed by that schema; readback_bytes is positive and readback_sha256 resolves complete canonical bytes including LF; launch and profile digests equal the same launch evidence and FD/config profile.
field_equality.trusted generated: Resolve discovery_output_root_sha256 and trusted_row_sha256 to one exact 14-key trusted-index row. Delete only trusted_row_sha256, hash the complete 13-key preimage, and require every direct field including exec_args_sha256 and exec_code_authority_sha256. The embedded generator origin hashes exactly; only the unique adjacent generated compile/exec pair may reuse this byte-identical origin.

origin_union.field_types: Every *_sha256 and nonnull *_sha256_or_null is exactly 64 lowercase hex. There is no separate depfile-ledger artifact: original depfile is retained exactly once as kind=depfile build-output object, and every verifier deterministically recomputes the normalized projection from those raw bytes under this rule. Twin raw depfile byte equality plus deterministic parse proves projection equality. Missing header,unledgered generated header,-MMD,rewritten depfile or prefix mismatch fails.

equality_projection.digest_rule: equality_projection_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical projection bytes including LF and is absent from it.
equality_projection.rule: The standalone projection has exact keys contract_sha256,rows,schema. Rows cover first all cpython then all project-native output role/path universes in strict build_kind,role,path byte order. Each pair resolves typed run0/run1 output rows; role/path/kind/mode/link/bytes/object bytes are identical and shared values repeat them, while stored row digests differ only because their normative preimages contain run_ordinal. For each build_kind, compare the two complete build-exec,build-input-pre,build-input-terminal,command-stream,generated-exec-image,temp-state indexes after replacing exactly top-level run_ordinal and every declared row run_ordinal with integer0. For generated-exec-image rows, recompute generated_exec_image_sha256 from the resulting normalized seven-key preimage before byte comparison. For each build-exec row with image_origin=prior-build-output, also replace image_provenance_sha256 by that recomputed normalized generated-exec-image row digest; tool-input provenance digests remain unchanged. Compare the two build-output indexes by the same ordinal replacement and recompute each build_output_sha256 from its resulting normalized nine-key preimage before byte comparison. These explicitly named digest rewrites are the complete ordinal-normalization transform; no other field or pointer changes. Within each run terminal input equals pre input after only phase replacement. Missing stage/build/ephemeral/project intermediate/stream/temp/object,unequal metadata/input/poststate or undeclared output fails.

generated_exec_image_index.digest_rule: generated_exec_image_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF and is absent from the index. generated_exec_image_sha256 is SHA-256 of the standalone canonical seven-key projection build_kind,bytes,consumer_exec_ordinal,image_path,object_sha256,producer_exec_ordinal,run_ordinal plus LF and is stored as the eighth key.
generated_exec_image_index.row_rule: The top-level build_kind/run_ordinal equal enclosing evidence and every row repeats both. project-native has empty rows because every executed image is tool-input. cpython rows are strict consumer ordinal and exactly one per build-exec prior-build-output. producer and consumer ordinals are nonnegative, producer strictly smaller, both resolve same-run exec rows; producer action created path. Immediately before consumer execve, controller opens regular nonsymlink O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW, records positive bytes/object hash, retains bytes and closes/proves fd; exec path/hash/provenance equal row. Reuse of pathname creates distinct consumer rows and retains each version. Row digest validates exact seven-key preimage. Missing producer,future/self,path race,unretained ephemeral,mislabeled tool or plan absence fails.

index.digest_rule: native_rebuild_evidence_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF and is absent from it.
index.row_rule: Exactly four rows ordered (cpython,0),(cpython,1),(project-native,0),(project-native,1). Each nested index top-level build_kind/run_ordinal equals this row's build_kind/ordinal, and every nested row repeats it; build-output/generated-exec contain only that run. Every nested byte count is positive and digest resolves retained canonical JSON under object_store_rule. build-exec covers every process/join and reviewed plan projection; generated-exec resolves every prior-build-output. build_input_pre_index has phase=pre-run and terminal has phase=terminal; both are retrievable, and terminal equals pre byte-for-byte after replacing only phase as specified. output,temp-state,command-stream cover their exact closures. CPython rows retain configure/make/install,ephemeral images,complete twin build/stage exports; project-native starts only after CPython equality and mounts exact run0 stage. Twin equality covers both input phases and generated-exec after only run-ordinal normalization. Digest-only evidence,mutation,partial log,omitted empty stream,unclosed process,mixed-run index or learned output fails.

native_rebuild_evidence.object_store_precondition: The P00 creation in object_store_rule occurs before first non-authoritative preflight, because immutable toolchain ledger and later accepted build-exec plan must be retrievable there. At creation both subdirectories are empty; accepted toolchain ledger is first permitted index. The phrase no output can authorize its own build means no output may authorize its own production, recipe, producer or an earlier/same exec. It does not forbid a completed same-run CPython generated executable from serving a strictly later consumer when its exact path/hash/order was already constrained by the independently accepted plan and generated-exec-image evidence.
native_rebuild_evidence.object_store_rule: Before either authority-bearing CPython twin, a reviewed P00 receipt creates empty /var/lib/temporac/replay-v4/native-build-v5/{objects,indexes} owner0:0 mode0700 on one local filesystem. The nonroot build streams each completed object/log/index to the native build controller, which publishes owner0:0 mode0600 immutable files by the controller durability write algorithm under objects/<sha256>.bin or indexes/<sha256>.json, with content-addressed EEXIST only on exact byte/owner/mode equality. Evidence paths contain exactly lowercase digest basenames, are reopened O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW with complete size/EOF/hash checks, and are retained through native-install, BASE, G5a, G5b and K7. Evidence index/equality rows are published only after all four runs join and all objects rehash. No recipe contains an output digest; no output can authorize its own build. The complete mandatory recovery profile is the exact object at /round7_native_wave2_closure/build_and_deploy/native_rebuild_evidence/content_store_recovery_profile with schema temporac.native-build-content-store-recovery.v6: the native-build root uses its own FD34 root-inode nonblocking flock, exact objects/indexes stale-temp scan, content-addressed EEXIST winner revalidation, own-temp cleanup, directory fsync and poison/redeploy rule. It does not borrow the controller request-prefix lattice and no native-build writer mutates without this profile.

temp_state_index.digest_rule: temp_state_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF and is absent from the index.
temp_state_index.row_rule: The index top-level build_kind/run_ordinal exactly equal the enclosing evidence row and every row repeats run_ordinal. It is the complete lstat roster, including the root row and empty directories, under exactly tmp,cache,home for cpython and project-native after the terminal command; project-native out is excluded because it is wholly in build-output, while cpython build/stage are wholly in build-output. Rows are strict root_role,path byte order, paths are relative and nonescaping, and root_role is cache,home,or tmp. kind is regular,directory,or symlink with the same bytes/hash/target/uid/gid/mode rules as build_input_terminal_index; regular/symlink objects are retained, directory hash is null. Socket,device,fifo,hardlink alias,mount change, undeclared root, outside write or omission fails. The two runs of one build_kind must be byte-identical after replacing only top-level/row run_ordinal by zero; allocator padding or filesystem enumeration order never enters canonical bytes.

project_build_input_index.digest_rule: project_build_input_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF. The digest is external and absent from the index.
project_build_input_index.rule: The future artifact has exactly top_level_closed_keys. rows equals required_rows byte-for-byte and in strict ASCII path order; each row binds the exact repository regular nonsymlink bytes and is disjoint from the 30-row executable source allowlist. contract_sha256 is the accepted Round9 successor. README.md is a build-only metadata input required by the bound pyproject.toml readme declaration; it is copied into no installed path and authorizes no import, compile or exec event. Missing, extra, changed, mutable-alias or digest-only input fails before Hatchling starts.

build_and_deploy.rebuild_equality: After both CPython runs and their complete native-rebuild equality validate, create two new nonoverlapping project-native instances of the same immutable build image. In each, create /build/temporac root0:0 mode0755 and nonwritable to uid65532; before dropping privilege precreate exact root-owned mountpoints /build/temporac/src,pyproject.toml,README.md,cpython-stage plus initially empty out,tmp,cache owner65532:65532 mode0700 and home owner65532:65532 mode0500 under umask077. Materialize all 30 source-allowlist rows and the one disjoint README build-input in a verified root lower tree, permit no other repository member, then bind-mount only src and the two root files read-only with directories0555,regular0444,exact symlinks. Bind-mount exact validated run0 CPython stage export read-only at cpython-stage. Parent remains unmounted/nonwritable to uid65532, so only out,tmp,cache are writable and home remains nonwritable; /opt/temporac/replay-v4 is absent. Execute as uid=gid=65532, no groups/capabilities, no_new_privs=1, then run project_wheel,supervisor_compile,fp_native_compile,supervisor_link,fp_compile,fp_link in exact order with identical paths/env/argv. The -P -s Hatchling call honors PYTHONHASHSEED=0,PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. CPython headers/libpython resolve only from staged sysroot; non-CPython system/compiler headers,crt objects and libraries resolve only from exact toolchain/build-image ledger; ELF RPATH names future final /opt runtime. Every executable/input resolves through accepted exec/tool/source/build-input ledgers; temp/cache writes stay under TMPDIR/XDG, no undeclared writable/current-tree path exists. After six commands reopen/rehash all source,README,pyproject,CPython-stage/tool inputs and require exact pre-run byte/mode/link/mount equality. Require complete project-out bytes/hashes, ELF/ZIP projections, all three retained kind=depfile raw build-output objects plus deterministic resolver validation/projection, complete tmp/cache/home index and separate per-command stdout/stderr/exit evidence byte-identical across twins after only run-ordinal normalization. Native FP objects/depfiles are retained intermediate rows and never installed separately. Only run0 project wheel,supervisor and extension outputs enter native-install; any nondeterminism,undeclared input,mutation,metadata drift or run-specific path fails.

recipe_artifact.digest_rule: native_build_recipe_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical six-key recipe bytes including LF. The digest is external and absent from the recipe.

normative_spec_index.digest_rule: normative_spec_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF and is absent from that index.
normative_spec_index.row_rule: Resolve each pointer in the exact accepted timestamped Amendment005 JSON and hash the complete canonical standalone value plus LF. Rows are exactly row_order. contract_sha256 is the accepted Round9 successor. Missing, extra, mutable-alias, self-pointer or alternate value encoding fails.

recipe_artifact.rule: contract_sha256 is the accepted Round9 successor; normative_spec_index_sha256 resolves the exact static build/deploy choices; source_allowlist_sha256 resolves every executable project/build source byte including the three future members; project_build_input_index_sha256 resolves the exact separate build-only README.md bytes required by pyproject.toml; toolchain_ledger_sha256 resolves the complete exact future-populated tool/input ledger. All five digests must be reviewed before any build. The recipe contains no output digest, bundle digest, environment, launch or own digest.

source_purpose.src/pams/temporac/_fp_control.c: Only the exact two-mode floating-point native ABI plus CPython extension wrappers, probe and readback. Its native object is linked into the supervisor and its extension object into _fp_control.so; it contains no teacher, metric, certificate, target or evaluator computation.
source_purpose.src/pams/temporac/_origin_supervisor.c: The sole controller and embedded-child executable source: request parsing, durable storage, fork/exec, FD/memfd transport, calls to the linked exact floating-point ABI, CPython initialization, native audit hook, framing, wait/join and fixed-error mapping. It contains no duplicate floating-point implementation.
source_purpose.src/pams/temporac/protocol_entry.py: The future byte-only dispatch ABI and exact owner table; it contains no native transport, build discovery or scientific-method change.
