build_exec_index.digest_rule: build_exec_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF. The digest is external and absent from the index.
build_exec_index.graph_and_resolver_rule: Rows are gap-free exact process-creation ordinal order. For build_kind=cpython there are exactly four null-parent roots, in execution order source_extract,configure,make,install. Their stage tokens are respectively those four literals; source_extract argv equals commands.source_extract and cwd=/build/temporac, while configure/make/install argv equal the same run_ordinal row's configure_argv/make_argv/install_argv in cpython.build_runs and cwd=/build/temporac/cpython-build. For build_kind=project-native there are exactly six null-parent roots, in execution order project_wheel,supervisor_compile,fp_native_compile,supervisor_link,fp_compile,fp_link; each stage equals that literal, argv equals the same-named commands array and cwd=/build/temporac. Every nonroot has one strictly smaller parent_ordinal_or_null, inherits exactly the unique root's stage token, and its parent chain terminates at that root; orphan,cycle,cross-root,cross-command or invented stage fails. The reviewed plan rows obey the identical root/parent/stage/argv/cwd rule after their declared projection. Before each authority run the controller reopens and validates the already accepted native-build recipe, its toolchain ledger and reviewed plan. At top level, build_exec_plan_sha256 equals SHA-256 of those exact retained temporac.native-build-exec-plan.v5 bytes; recipe_normative_spec_index_sha256 equals normative_spec_index_sha256 inside that preexisting recipe; build_image_sha256 equals sha256 of the unique role=build-image row in that recipe's exact toolchain ledger. The later enclosing native-rebuild-evidence top-level native_build_recipe_sha256 and build_exec_plan_sha256 bind those same earlier inputs and never supply a value backward in time. For each image_origin=tool-input row, image_path and image_sha256 equal the unique executable tool-ledger row's absolute path_or_image_reference and sha256, and image_provenance_sha256 equals that row's tool_row_sha256. For each image_origin=prior-build-output row, image_path,image_sha256 and image_provenance_sha256 equal the same-run generated-exec-image row's image_path,object_sha256 and generated_exec_image_sha256 whose consumer_exec_ordinal equals this row ordinal. No arbitrary digest, alternate ledger, cross-run resolver or unresolved top-level value is accepted.
build_exec_index.row_rule: Top-level build_kind/run_ordinal identify one cpython or project-native run and every row repeats ordinal. Rows are exact process creation order governed by graph_and_resolver_rule. argv is a nonempty exact array; cwd is absolute and obeys cwd_rule; exit_code=0; image_path is regular nonsymlink and image_sha256 hashes the bytes opened by execve. environment is the complete actual execve envp as an ordered JSON string array: each element is strict UTF-8 KEY=VALUE, key matches ASCII [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, keys are unique, no NUL occurs and order is preserved. environment_sha256 hashes the standalone canonical array plus LF. Every outer recipe-command row environment equals build_environment.envp byte-for-byte and in order. Child/subtool rows may differ only by their exact array frozen in the reviewed plan; no secret,clock,random,PID-dependent,host fallback or unreviewed variable is permitted, and authority rows match the plan. Non-env cwd/uid/gid/groups/capabilities/network/no_new_privs/umask remain bound by the build_environment normative digest/top recipe and are not packed into the environment hash. image_origin is exactly tool-input or prior-build-output and all image/provenance fields resolve under graph_and_resolver_rule. Shell builtins create no row but the containing image,script and input remain exact. Failed,extra,reordered,mixed-run,PATH-substituted or unledgered exec fails.

build_exec_plan.digest_rule: build_exec_plan_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical plan bytes including LF and is absent from the plan. After independent acceptance and before any authority-bearing run, the native build controller publishes those exact bytes at native-build-v5/indexes/<build_exec_plan_sha256>.json under object_store_rule; every later reference reopens, EOF-checks, rehashes and byte-identically reserializes that retained object.

preflight_exec_index.digest_rule: preflight_build_exec_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF and is external to that index. Exact bytes are published and retained under native_rebuild_evidence.object_store_rule before the preflight pipeline or plan is accepted.
preflight_exec_index.rule: This is the non-authorizing preflight analogue of temporac.native-build-exec-index.v5 and is captured before any plan or authority native-rebuild evidence exists. Top-level and row build_kind/run_ordinal, the exact four-or-six process-root sets, parent-chain/stage/argv/cwd clauses, complete environment and exit_code=0 obey the row and graph rules of the authority schema; its plan-dependent and later-native-rebuild resolver clauses are expressly inapplicable. Before each preflight, the controller reopens the already independently reviewed frozen native-build recipe and its toolchain ledger; recipe_normative_spec_index_sha256 equals that recipe's exact field and build_image_sha256 equals the unique role=build-image tool row sha256. A tool-input image_provenance_sha256 is the unique same-ledger tool_row_sha256; a prior-build-output value is the same-preflight-run generated_exec_image_sha256 with matching consumer ordinal. The later enclosing preflight-pipeline top-level native_build_recipe_sha256 binds those same previously existing recipe bytes and its row binds this exact preflight index digest; neither relationship supplies a value backward in time. Any reference to authority native-rebuild evidence, mixed authority bytes, plan backfill, alternate recipe/tool ledger, unresolved generated image, host fallback or post-capture rewrite fails.

preflight_pipeline.digest_rule: preflight_pipeline_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical pipeline bytes including LF and is absent from it. The pipeline and every nested index are immutable retrievable objects under native_rebuild_evidence.object_store_rule; the later accepted plan contains only this external digest plus its run-independent row projection.
preflight_pipeline.rule: contract_sha256 is the accepted Round9 successor and native_build_recipe_sha256 hashes the exact independently reviewed frozen recipe; neither may be caller-selected or learned from a preflight. Rows are exactly (cpython,0),(cpython,1),(project-native,0),(project-native,1). First execute only the two fresh CPython preflights under that recipe; in each row preflight_build_exec_index_sha256 resolves only a retained temporac.native-build-preflight-exec-index.v5 object, never an authority temporac.native-build-exec-index.v5 object, and the other fields resolve complete input-pre/input-terminal/output/command-stream/generated-exec/temp-state indexes using the same closed schemas and byte-retention rules as authority evidence. Validate their complete twin equality under native_rebuild_evidence.equality_projection, including normalized typed row digests. selected_cpython_stage_build_output_index_sha256 then equals only the CPython preflight run0 build-output index digest; its complete cpython-stage-export projection is byte-identical to run1 and is mounted read-only at /build/temporac/cpython-stage for each later project-native preflight, with a complete bijection to that preflight's input-pre and terminal cpython-stage rows. Only after this equality do the two project-native preflights run; their complete nested indexes likewise validate twin equality. For each build kind, projecting either preflight exec index by deleting exit_code,run_ordinal,image_provenance_sha256 and injecting enclosing build_kind yields exactly the same ordered plan rows. No preflight output, selected stage or nested digest may enter native-install, substitute for an authority output, grant experiment authority or modify science; it survives only as immutable evidence transitively resolved by the reviewed plan and is retained through K7. Missing output object, CPython-stage source ambiguity, host/authority-stage use, cross-run mount, unequal twin, plan backedge or discarded evidence fails.

build_exec_plan.rule: The future artifact has exactly top_level_closed_keys. preflight_pipeline_sha256 resolves the complete validated four-row non-authorizing pipeline above. Rows are cpython then project-native and within kind gap-free process order; for each kind they byte-equal the unique run-independent projection reproduced by both corresponding preflight exec indexes. Rows contain no run ordinal,exit code,image-provenance row digest,authority output digest or authority-run value. Each embeds the exact actual ordered environment array and its standalone-array digest; outer rows equal build_environment.envp, while subtool differences are fully explicit/reviewed and deterministic with no secret,clock,random,PID or host value. image_origin is tool-input or prior-build-output; the plan commits exact image path/object hash, only tool input exists pre-build, and prior output is restricted to CPython generated tools equal across both CPython preflights. Independent review accepts the complete pipeline and this one plan before any authority-bearing run. Each authority exec index binds the plan; remove only exit_code,run_ordinal,image_provenance_sha256, inject enclosing build_kind, canonicalize and require row byte equality. No other field changes and every exit code is zero. Preflight artifacts are transitive plan evidence only and never native-install or scientific outputs.

tool_ledger.digest_rule: toolchain_ledger_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical native-toolchain-ledger bytes including LF and is absent from the ledger. Before any preflight it is independently accepted and published owner0:0 mode0600 at /var/lib/temporac/replay-v4/native-build-v5/indexes/<toolchain_ledger_sha256>.json; every recipe/plan/run reference reopens O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW, validates regular file/EOF/bytes/hash and byte-identical canonical reserialization.
tool_ledger.population_rule: The native-build recipe and pure immutable toolchain ledger are accepted before preflight and contain no run-output digest. Run the two non-authoritative CPython clean-image preflights first, retain their complete typed indexes and validate full twin output/evidence equality. Mount only the validated run0 preflight stage projection read-only into two later non-authoritative project-native preflights; retain and compare their complete indexes. Publish the exact four-row preflight pipeline, independently review its two-kind run-independent exec projection and accept one plan. Only then may the four authority-bearing runs start, each matching the reviewed plan row-for-row while retaining its own exit/run evidence and all declared outputs; authority project-native runs still mount only authority CPython run0 after authority CPython twin equality. These provenance validations are not experiment jobs and add no GPU hours,data access or claim. Preflight bytes cannot enter native-install or authorize scientific execution and are retained only as exact plan evidence transitively resolved by native-rebuild evidence.
tool_ledger.rule: Rows begin with exactly one nonnull row for every required_role_order token in that listed order. Any additional immutable pre-build executable is role=exec-image and follows in strict UTF-8 absolute path_or_image_reference order. role/path pairs and absolute paths are unique; a required-role row that itself names an executable directly serves as that image and is never duplicated as exec-image. Each row's tool_row_sha256 is SHA-256 of the standalone canonical five-key projection bytes,path_or_image_reference,role,sha256,version plus LF. Files bind exact absolute regular nonsymlink bytes/hashes; directory-like header/crt/build-image/Hatchling roles bind complete retained ASCII-path ordered member-index bytes/hash and use a fixed image-reference token declared by role. Every external executable permitted by bash/make/GCC/binutils/Hatchling/CPython build orchestration has exactly one row; CPython executables generated within the same run are deliberately absent and use build-exec image_origin=prior-build-output. The stated GCC/ld versions and target reproduce from exact binaries. This ledger contains no preflight/authoritative exec or output digest. Missing/duplicate/unindexed extra, host fallback, generated-output backedge or digest-only input fails.

association_preimage.hash: association_sha256 is SHA-256 of this exact standalone canonical JSON object including LF; the installed index row repeats the fifteen non-schema values and adds only association_sha256.

completion_index.digest_rule: executable_origin_trace_completion_index_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical index bytes including LF and is external to the index. The exact bytes remain retrievable through G5a,G5b and K7.
completion_index.rule: The G5a-bound index has exactly top_level_closed_keys and exactly 54 rows: the first 54 dispatch owner strings, excluding G5A-COMMIT,G5B-JOIN,K7-FINAL, each once in strict printable-ASCII entrypoint_owner order. launch_instance_bytes and trace_bytes are positive exact canonical byte counts including LF and their digests hash those complete retained bytes. Each launch parses as temporac.native-launch-instance.v5 and resolves one exact full-runtime launch-evidence row; each trace parses as temporac.executable-origin-trace.v6, repeats the same launch digest, contract, source/installed/runtime/FINAL environment lineage, controller request, stream/join/mapping evidence and status PASS. The request-keyed durability attestation must resolve that same final_trace_sha256 and launch evidence before the row is eligible. The same owner must also have the unique accepted inventory receipt constructed only after its caller observed the exact type0x7e frame,EOF and controller exit0; a root-visible Z candidate alone is ineligible. Top contract_sha256 is the accepted Round9 successor, environment_sha256 hashes the one exact final CPU environment and source_allowlist_sha256 resolves the BASE allowlist. The three post-G5a owners are finalized only as surrounding controller trace evidence after their calls return and never enter or mutate this pre-G5a index, receipt root, capability or result. Missing/extra/duplicate owner, v4 trace substitution, digest-only launch, cross-request attestation, post-G5a backfill or trace-to-environment feedback fails.

code_and_install_closure.installed_ledger: The preserved installed-distribution-member-index is complete, ASCII-path ordered and duplicate-free for exactly the noneditable project wheel and every third-party wheel. Each accepted row is wheel-member and binds distribution, version, normalized path, kind, exact installed bytes/count/hash, wheel member path/hash and repository path/hash or explicit no-repository-member through the standalone 16-key v4 association preimage. CPython members are instead complete in cpython-runtime-member-index; supervisor and _fp_control are instead native-build-output rows in native-install-index plus ELF index; none is falsely encoded by the wheel-only v4 association. No glob or dynamic fallback exists.
code_and_install_closure.normalization: Use the preserved normalize_rel_posix_ascii algorithm: printable strict ASCII, NFC unchanged, slash only, no NUL/backslash/colon/absolute/trailing/repeated slash/empty/dot/dotdot segment, no case fold, percent decode, realpath or separator rewrite. Every present/null discriminator and installed/wheel/repository/origin kind is explicit in the canonical association row.
code_and_install_closure.origin_preimage: Every trace origin is one closed typed canonical JSON object with a kind-specific exact key set. origin_sha256 is SHA-256 of those standalone bytes including LF; it contains distribution/version/member/install/repository/native/generated identity as applicable. Alternate tagged binary, delimiter encoding, renamed field, omitted null, path alias, member swap or digest-only substitute fails.
code_and_install_closure.project_equality: For every project-installed row, installed bytes equal the corresponding project-wheel member and repository association byte-for-byte. For every imported/executed project row, those same bytes additionally equal one exact precommitted source-allowlist row; non-allowlisted installed project members have exact zero executable/import events. protocol_entry is loaded only from this noneditable installed wheel under the isolated module_search_paths.
code_and_install_closure.runtime_entry: There is no python -I -m bootstrap. execve enters the exact native supervisor ELF; the child installs its audit hook, validates transport, configures isolated embedded CPython with the preserved 10+64 field profile and exact module_search_paths, then imports protocol_entry only after the pre-dispatch import/trusted-generated prefix.

source_allowlist.digest_rule: source_allowlist_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete canonical temporac.source-byte-allowlist.v5 bytes including LF. The digest is external and absent from the index.
source_allowlist.row_rule: rows occur exactly in required_repository_paths_ascii_order. bytes is a positive integer, sha256 hashes the exact complete repository file bytes, path repeats the listed ASCII path, and roles is a nonempty ASCII-sorted unique subset of build-input,project-metadata,python-import. pyproject has [build-input,project-metadata]; the two C sources have [build-input]; every Python source has [build-input,python-import] because the noneditable wheel build consumes it. No other role token exists.
source_allowlist.rule: The list is exact, complete, ASCII byte ordered and no-glob. A separately authorized future implementation must add the three presently absent successor sources and obtain an implementation review before any P00/P06 build; their present absence is SPECIFIED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and blocks execution, not this specification review. Every imported/executed repository byte resolves to exactly one row and every row resolves to an installed/build association; no current-tree fallback or unlisted dynamic open exists.

code_and_install_closure.trace_role: The post-run executable-origin trace validates every imported/executed/native origin against the precommitted installed/source/ELF ledgers. It is evidence only and never feeds back into those ledgers, BASE, FINAL, environment, launch or capability.

child_fd_actions.controller_output_preservation: After complete request parsing/hash,acquire/promote and hold publication root FD34,classify/publish/reopen R,duplicate original FD1 by F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC(min32) to exact32 and original FD2 to exact33,then close/prove controller0/1/2. Close every other non-required descriptor while explicitly retaining only FD32,FD33,FD34. FD34 remains parent-held through the request and is never swept by a generic fd>=3 rule. At fork the child inherits that OFD only through the finite raw close34,prove34,close50,prove50 prefix; no blocking child operation may retain34 or50. No child target,carrier,barrier or monitor FD exists before the per-child construction.

inter_run_teardown.algorithm: Discovery only: after run0 all tasks are terminal, FD48 has reached validated EOF, every frame is parsed, the provisional process row and its digest are frozen in memory, and waitpid(-1,__WALL|WNOHANG) plus signalfd drains report no pending child state, issue epoll_ctl(FD52,DEL,FD48) then DEL FD51 with exact zero returns, close52,close51,close48 in that order, require fcntl(F_GETFD)=-1/EBADF for each, drain waitpid again to ECHILD and prove the physical open set is exactly32,33,34 with0..31 absent. Only then may run1 fresh targets,FD48,49,50,51,52 be constructed. No run0 request-level K,L,S,J,result or attestation is claimed or published at this boundary.
inter_run_teardown.postcondition: The retained run0 provisional/process bytes are immutable and independent of the closed descriptors. The root lock FD34 and preserved outputs32/33 remain open; there is no pending SIGCHLD/signalfd record, hidden monitor OFD or reusable epoll registration. Full-runtime and discovery run1 skip this inter-run transition and use terminal restoration.

monitor_fd_construction_spec.rule: Exactly two rows in ordinal order SIGNALFD then EPOLL. Every row schema is temporac.ptrace-monitor-fd-construction-row.v5. Before each creation FD0..31 are absent and the retained open set is exactly preconstruction_open_fds plus any already promoted monitor FD. signalfd4 and epoll_create1 must each return raw FD0; dup3 promotes it to final51 or52 with O_CLOEXEC, exact flags are read back, raw0 is closed and fcntl(F_GETFD) returns EBADF. Numeric future flag/errno fields resolve the accepted runtime constant ledger or fresh fcntl readback; schema/kind/ordinal/raw/final fds are the exact static values. Static and future fields are disjoint and their union equals row_closed_keys.

ordinary_failure_teardown.order: Freeze the first failure and the exact open-FD/identity snapshot. First run ptrace failure_cleanup for failure-epoch live tasks. Then close/EBADF-prove each open child target0..8,proc scratch40/41,stream48,attach49/50 and monitor51/52 in ascending numeric order without closing an absent/reused number. Apply ordinary_error_cleanup to every recorded publication/scan/winner/temp FD while retaining34. When durable cleanup is complete,unlock and close/EBADF-prove34. Finally restore32->1 and33->2 under the existing output partition and close/prove32/33. Raw transient descriptors are closed by recorded identity before their containing directory. No generic range sweep,blind retry,hidden FD or normal return with an unproved descriptor is legal.
ordinary_failure_teardown.postconditions: Before a normal failure frame the only open descriptor is restored FD1 until its checked output close; FD2 emits no byte. Before process exit all fixed and transient descriptors are closed/EBADF-proved except an unrecoverable close-proof path,which emits no byte and relies on process exit. Cleanup never changes the first stage or deletes a successfully renamed final.

per_child_creation_order: Reserve raw0/1/2 with three exact /dev/null opens and install mode targets in the existing numeric construction order while retaining only controller FDs32,33,34. Target FD6 remains a blocking write OFD.

Construct the FD6/FD48 pipe with pipe2(O_CLOEXEC); promote the read end to exact48, set and verify O_NONBLOCK only on FD48 while re-verifying FD6 is blocking, and close all raw aliases. Construct and freeze the existing FD7 carrier only after launch inputs are complete.

Construct the attach pipe last,promote child read to49 and parent write to50,close raw aliases,and prove immediately-before-fork open set equals the mode child targets plus32,33,34,48,49,50. fork exactly once. The fixed child raw stub executes close(34)=0,fcntl(34,F_GETFD)=-1/EBADF,close(50)=0,fcntl(50,F_GETFD)=-1/EBADF,then read(49,&byte,1). These are the only permitted pre-attach syscalls and no blocking operation precedes both close proofs. A prefix mismatch or first-read EOF/wrong byte takes the direct failure/exit path and releases every inherited OFD; no libc,allocation,mapping,signal change or exec occurs.

In the parent immediately close/readback FD7, then close/readback all other child-only targets in ascending order: discovery 0,1,2,6,8; full 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,8. Close/readback parent FD49. The open set is now exactly32,33,34,48,50 with 0..31 empty.

The parent PTRACE_SEIZEs/PTRACE_INTERRUPTs the child wherever it is in the finite reviewed close34,prove34,close50,prove50,read49 stub. The accepted initial object closes SETUP,ENTRY/in-flight and EXIT for every prefix syscall. Under PTRACE_SYSCALL the parent drives and records the exact remaining suffix until the child is stopped at read49 ENTRY or was already blocked in that read; the state-dependent child snapshot must prove34 and50 absent at that boundary. Only then create signalfd4 and epoll exactly under monitor_fd_construction: raw0 to51,close0,raw0 to52,close0; register51 and nonblocking48 in52; write exactly byte01 to the parent-only50 and close/readback50.

After the first read completes with one byte01,the child closes/proves32,33,48 in that order,performs a second read49 returning exact EOF,closes/proves49,restores the frozen child mask and directly execs. Parent resumes only by PTRACE_SYSCALL and retains32,33,34,48,51,52 for that child. Full-runtime and discovery run1 retain them until terminal publication/cleanup; discovery run0 performs the exact inter_run_teardown after its terminal provisional row and before fresh run1 construction.
child_fd_actions.restoration: For full-runtime or discovery run1, after all tasks are terminal and K/stream/join/trace/result/attestation are durably complete as an immutable candidate, drain and close/prove FD48,51,52; complete durability under FD34; close/release/prove34; require FD1/2 free, restore32->1 and33->2, close/prove32/33 and emit the sole result. Discovery run0 instead uses inter_run_teardown and retains32/33/34. On failure first apply exact ptrace failure_cleanup to failure-epoch live tasks, apply ordinary_failure_teardown: close/EBADF-prove every exact open child,target,proc-scratch,stream,attach,monitor and publication FD while retaining34 until durable cleanup, then release34 and restore outputs. FD32/original result failure emits no bytes exit124; sole FD33 restoration failure retains prior stage or selects OUTPUT and exits123 on valid FD1. Cleanup never overwrites the first failure. Any failure after candidate completion retains the exact prefix under COMMITTED_NONREPLAYABLE; only the later exact type0x7e frame,EOF and exit0 accept controller success.
child_fd_actions.scratch_rule: The complete descriptor vocabulary is targets0..8,carrier7,preserved32/33,locked root34,procfs scratch40/41,stream48,attach49/50 and parent monitor51/52. Immediately before fork the set is targets+32,33,34,48,49,50. The child fixed prefix closes and EBADF-proves inherited34 then50 before blocking on49; the parent retains its own34/50. After the parent closes carrier,targets,49 it is exactly32,33,34,48,50; both monitor creations use verified raw0 then dup3 to51/52. During each stopped address snapshot only the closed proc_snapshot_fd_contract may temporarily add40/41 and it restores the prior exact set. Discovery run0 closes48/51/52 at inter_run_teardown before run1. Any hidden descriptor,lowest-free mismatch,FD48/FD6 status alias,unlisted child-prefix syscall,early release or controller FD at exec fails.

attempt_marker.rule: Immediately after exact durable request validation and before prelaunch or child creation, publish attempts/<controller_request_sha256>.json through the same sibling-temp, fdatasync, file-fsync, RENAME_NOREPLACE, directory-fsync, reopen/rehash algorithm. Final EEXIST is forbidden. The exact five-key marker has created_before_child_count=0, request mode, state=CLAIMED and schema temporac.native-controller-attempt-marker.v5; its external digest hashes canonical bytes plus LF. Once its directory fsync is durable the authority call is permanently burned; malformed direct-final/O_EXCL publication is forbidden.

attestation_values.discover-twin: state=DURABLE_REHASH_COMPLETE and status=PASS; attempt_marker_sha256, child_stream_index_sha256_or_null, discovery_evidence_index_sha256_or_null, kernel_transition_index_sha256, launch_evidence_index_sha256_or_null, process_join_index_sha256_or_null, publication_recovery and publication_recovery_sha256 are present and exact; final_trace_sha256_or_null is null; result_payload_sha256 hashes the complete discovery result. Recovery digest/object and every referenced durable object revalidate.
attestation_values.full-runtime: state=DURABLE_REHASH_COMPLETE and status=PASS; attempt_marker_sha256, child_stream_index_sha256_or_null, final_trace_sha256_or_null, kernel_transition_index_sha256, launch_evidence_index_sha256_or_null, process_join_index_sha256_or_null, publication_recovery and publication_recovery_sha256 are present and exact; discovery_evidence_index_sha256_or_null is null; result_payload_sha256 hashes the complete dispatch result. Recovery digest/object and every referenced durable object revalidate.
attestation_values.rule: mode is exactly discover-twin or full-runtime. Any other state/status token,null/present pattern,digest not resolving to the just-persisted object,cross-request object,missing launch evidence,or attestation created before reopen/rehash fails. Before any Z final is installed,a failure creates no PASS attestation. Successful Z rename plus attestations-directory fsync makes the installed final irreversible; successful read-only reopen,complete read,EOF and rehash establishes the exact durable candidate while FD34 remains held. Any later teardown,restoration or output failure cannot delete or relabel that candidate: a fresh scan retains the complete exact prefix as COMMITTED_NONREPLAYABLE. The persisted candidate grants controller success or downstream authority only when the same invocation subsequently yields the exact sequence-zero type0x7e frame,EOF and controller exit0 after every required terminal descriptor teardown and output restoration. publication_recovery is the exact embedded temporac.native-publication-recovery.v6 object and its paired digest; kernel_transition_index_sha256 resolves the just-published K object for this request/process set.

eexist.algorithm: Before temp creation open and completely classify an allowed existing final,recording rather than immediately returning any mismatch,then close/EBADF-prove it. On renameat2 EEXIST,open and completely classify the winner; regardless of exact/mismatch outcome close/prove own temp if open,revalidate its exact basename/inode,unlink only that temp,fsync directory,prove temp ENOENT,close/prove first winner FD,reopen and fully revalidate winner identity,bytes,EOF,schema,path-key,digest and every cross-edge,then close/prove it. Only an exact allowed winner returns REUSED_EXISTING; mismatch remains observable invalid after loser cleanup.
eexist.forbidden_rule: Attempt marker and attestation EEXIST are forbidden. A mismatching winner is never deleted,although the exact own temp is still cleaned before persistent-invalid failure. Any cleanup error retains the first failure and follows ordinary_error_cleanup. No normal return leaves this process temp or any unproved transient FD.

ordinary_error_cleanup.close_primitive: For every recorded open transient descriptor call close(fd) exactly once and never retry close,including after EINTR. Immediately call fcntl(fd,F_GETFD) and require -1/EBADF. A close error remains the first error only when no earlier operation failed; cleanup never replaces an already selected first failure. Close content,winner,reopen,temp and scan-entry FDs before their containing directory FD. The initial root_open_raw and locked root_identity_reopen are each exact raw FD3 and are close/EBADF-proved on every success/failure prefix; successful promotion leaves only FD34. FD34 is retained through durable cleanup and then unlocked,closed once and EBADF-proved. Any required controller close or EBADF-proof failure,whether first or secondary,preserves the selected stage or selects DURABILITY if none,emits no frame and exits124; process-exit kernel teardown releases every descriptor whose close/proof failed. It never deletes an installed final or claims an already durable prefix is absent. If an exact Z final is observable and the complete prefix revalidates,the prefix remains COMMITTED_NONREPLAYABLE and grants no accepted success without the exact outer success condition; otherwise the observable prefix retains its existing lattice state. A native-build writer analog exits nonzero with no accepted index and likewise retains every installed final.
ordinary_error_cleanup.creator_binding: The two temp-basename decimals equal the publisher's actual positive getpid() and field22 starttime_ticks from the fixed /proc/self/stat. Read starttime immediately before creation and require it unchanged immediately after openat plus fstat identity verification. Decimal strings have no leading zero. Recovery never performs PID-liveness inference and validates historical temps only by grammar,metadata,root identity and recorded creator fields.
ordinary_error_cleanup.failure_rule: The first failing operation and its already selected stage/exit remain authoritative; cleanup never overwrites them and serializes no errno or message. TEMP_OPEN first close/proves the temp and then performs TEMP_CLOSED cleanup. TEMP_CLOSED revalidates the exact basename and recorded dev,inode,uid,gid,mode,nlink,unlinks only that identity,fsyncs the directory and proves fstatat(AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW)=ENOENT before NO_TEMP. A substituted identity is never deleted and is persistently invalid. FINAL_RENAMED never deletes or replaces the final: close/prove all transients,prove temp ENOENT and require a fresh full scan after directory-fsync,reopen,readback or close failure. Normal success closes/proves every transient FD before the exact pre-fork scan.

state_postconditions.FINAL_RENAMED: The exact final names the recorded temp inode, the temp name is absent, no final deletion is permitted and every transient FD is close/EBADF-proved.
state_postconditions.NO_TEMP: No current temp pathname or transient FD remains; directory identity is unchanged.
state_postconditions.TEMP_CLOSED: The temp pathname still names the recorded inode and the temp FD is close/EBADF-proved.
state_postconditions.TEMP_OPEN: The temp pathname and the one recorded temp FD name the same verified inode; no rename occurred.

state_transitions: Successful openat(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) plus complete fstat identity verification changes NO_TEMP to TEMP_OPEN.
The one checked close plus F_GETFD=-1/EBADF changes TEMP_OPEN to TEMP_CLOSED.
Successful renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) changes TEMP_CLOSED to FINAL_RENAMED and requires temp ENOENT.
RENAME_NOREPLACE EEXIST leaves TEMP_CLOSED until exact loser cleanup reaches NO_TEMP.
No transition leaves FINAL_RENAMED and the installed final is never unlinked,overwritten or truncated.

durability.path_key_rule: requests,launch,streams,joins,traces and results are keyed by the SHA-256 of their complete stored bytes. attempts and attestations are request-keyed state objects and prelaunch is keyed by the exact embedded launch digest although its seven-key wrapper has different bytes; those three are never called content-addressed and EEXIST always fails for state/attestation while prelaunch EEXIST requires exact wrapper equality. Angle-bracket tokens are substituted by exactly one 64-lowercase-hex digest with no delimiter or case alternative. traces is an exact schema-discriminated union: temporac.kernel-transition-index.v8 is keyed by kernel_transition_index_sha256 and temporac.executable-origin-trace.v6 by final_trace_sha256; one stored object must parse as exactly one variant.

state_rules.ABSENT: No current R,A,Z or current-bound descendant exists after successful cleanup/rescan. A new R may be published.
state_rules.CLAIMED_INCOMPLETE: R and A exist,Z does not,and descendants form exactly one contiguous listed prefix. The marker burned the invocation; no child,resume or retry is permitted. After startup maintenance emit the existing failure with stage=ATTEMPT_MARKER,exit123 and retain the prefix.
state_rules.COMMITTED_NONREPLAYABLE: Z and the complete exact prefix exist and all bytes/FKs revalidate. This root-visible state does not assert whether the originating invocation later completed terminal descriptor teardown,output restoration and the exact outer success condition. Without the same invocation's validated sequence-zero type0x7e frame,EOF and controller exit0,Z is an immutable committed candidate but grants no accepted success or downstream authority. With or without that outer observation,a second child,result replay or success envelope is forbidden. After any recorded cleanup of unrelated legal stale temps,emit the existing failure with stage=DURABLE_REQUEST,exit123,null launch and zero current-request publication.
state_rules.INVALID_PREFIX: A structurally invalid current prefix found only after successful cleanup/rescan emits stage=DURABLE_REQUEST,exit123,null launch and zero current-request publication; unrelated startup cleanup may already have occurred. A persistent invalid entry found in VALIDATE_ONLY performs literal zero root mutation.
state_rules.REQUEST_DURABLE_UNCLAIMED: Only exact R is durable and A,Z,descendants are absent after successful cleanup/rescan. This crash-before-marker state alone may continue by publishing A; R bytes are not rewritten.

prelaunch_record.rule: Each bytes_hex is lowercase complete canonical bytes including LF and hashes exactly. Launch resolves the same controller request/mode and the operational construction index resolves exactly its fd rows while excluding FD7. Carrier construction resolves exact FD7 evidence and contains the canonical carrier over these launch bytes. The complete seven-key prelaunch record is persisted at prelaunch/<launch_instance_sha256>.json and reopens byte-identically before fork; the path key is the embedded launch digest, not a digest of the wrapper, and EEXIST still requires complete wrapper equality.

publication_lock.acquire_order: After complete request canonicalization and digest computation but before durable mutation,the controller open set is exactly0,1,2. Open the P00-fixed root O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW and require raw FD3; fstat its exact st_dev/st_ino,uid0,gid0,mode0700 and fixed mount. Promote only by fcntl(3,F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC,34),require result34,then close3 exactly once and require fcntl(3,F_GETFD)=-1/EBADF before flock(34,LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB). Retry only EINTR. EWOULDBLOCK,ENOTSUP or any open,fstat,promotion or flock acquisition failure selects DURABLE_REQUEST,zero durable mutation and zero child,with intended framed exit123 only if ordinary_error_cleanup subsequently closes and EBADF-proves every descriptor it actually opened. Any close or EBADF-proof failure in this acquisition sequence,including FD3 or FD34 and whether primary or secondary,preserves the selected stage or selects DURABILITY,emits no frame and exits124 under close_primitive; it never falls through to exit123. While locked,reopen the same absolute root and require raw FD3,the identical device/inode/mount/metadata,then close/prove3 before request publication. Thus the steady lock state is exactly0,1,2,34; no raw or identity-reopen descriptor survives.
publication_lock.filesystem_contract: P00 must precommit the exact local filesystem type and mount options and their support for directory flock, renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), fdatasync, file fsync and directory fsync. Unsupported or changed semantics fail before an authority call.
publication_lock.release: The parent holds FD34 through startup scan,classification,every write,directory fsync,reopen/rehash and terminal state. The fixed child stub executes close34,fcntl(34,F_GETFD)->EBADF,close50,fcntl(50,F_GETFD)->EBADF before any potentially blocking operation. If the parent dies before successful PTRACE_SEIZE,the child reaches read49 with no inherited lock OFD or pipe writer,observes EOF,closes its remaining inherited descriptors and exits; after successful SEIZE,PTRACE_O_EXITKILL terminates it on tracer death. A prefix mismatch forces direct child failure/process exit,which releases every inherited OFD. Thus no child can retain the publication flock indefinitely after a parent crash. No compliant writer mutates this root without the same lock.

action_domains.REQUEST_STATE_CLASSIFIED: directory=requests; state one exact lattice token; final/object/temp null

publication_recovery.digest_rule: SHA-256 of the complete canonical recovery object including one terminal LF; digest is external.
publication_recovery.initial_state_rule: initial_state equals the state of the unique REQUEST_STATE_CLASSIFIED row. VALIDATE_ONLY_SCAN_COMPLETED is first,followed by ordered stale removals,POST_CLEANUP_RESCAN_COMPLETED and exactly one classification; later reuse/EEXIST rows follow publication order. An invalid first pass has no PASS recovery artifact. Lock,row order,state and every null/present pattern are exact.
publication_recovery.lock_rule: lock is the exact four-key readback of the held publication_lock: lock_fd=34, method=flock-root-inode-exclusive-nonblocking, and root_device/root_inode equal both locked-FD fstat and the locked absolute-path reopen. Any mismatch fails before publication.
publication_recovery.row_order: VALIDATE_ONLY_SCAN_COMPLETED is ordinal0; stale removals follow fixed directory/name order; POST_CLEANUP_RESCAN_COMPLETED follows; exactly one REQUEST_STATE_CLASSIFIED follows; later existing-final or rename-EEXIST events follow publication order. Ordinals are gap-free.

publish_order.rule: Each object is fully published, directory-fsynced, reopened and rehashed before the next. K is exactly one request-level kernel-transition index: two ordered process rows for discover-twin and one for full-runtime. The recovery row records reuse/EEXIST actions in this same order. Result stdout is emitted only after the final attestation reopens and rehashes. No later object backfills an earlier preimage.

durability.retention: Every published request,attempt marker,prelaunch record,launch evidence index,child-stream index,process-join index,kernel-transition index,final trace,inner result and durability attestation is immutable and remains readable at its exact durable path through G5a,G5b and K7 completion. A complete Z prefix is an immutable candidate; no resolver or downstream consumer may treat it as accepted success without the originating invocation's exact validated sequence-zero type0x7e frame,EOF and controller exit0. A committed candidate lacking that outer success observation and every failed-attempt request/marker/prelaunch prefix remain retained for nonretry audit but grant no PASS authority. Deletion,garbage collection,path migration,mutable alias,digest-only replacement or early reuse fails the corresponding downstream resolver.

root_poison.persistent_root_invalid: Only a currently observable invalid root,directory,final or temp entry is PERSISTENT_ROOT_INVALID: unknown basename,bad suffix,symlink,hardlink,wrong owner/mode/type/device/nlink,substituted identity,malformed retained final or invalid prefix. Every fresh controller fails until P00 repairs or replaces that observable root. No unrecorded cross-process poison bit is claimed.
root_poison.rule: Poison scope is determined only by a fresh complete scan. No journal or in-memory prior-process fact authorizes persistence. The first validate-only pass with an invalid entry performs literal zero mutation. Cleanup never deletes an invalid or substituted entry.
root_poison.transient_cleanup_failure: A syscall,I/O,close,unlink,fsync,ENOENT-proof or reopen failure with no observed invalid entry is TRANSIENT_CLEANUP_FAILURE for only the current request. It creates no child or PASS,may leave a still-legal stale temp and requires a fresh controller to rerun the complete four-phase scan. It is never called permanent poison across processes.

durability.root_precondition: A separately reviewed P00 deployment receipt proves that the root and exact child directories requests,attempts,prelaunch,launch,streams,joins,traces,results,attestations exist before the first controller request, are initially empty, regular directories on one local filesystem, owner 0:0, mode 0700, nonsymlink, non-mountpoint, and opened through one O_DIRECTORY|O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW root fd. On every later request the controller revalidates the same root/directory identities, ownership/modes and mount. Existing entries are permitted only when they are immutable retained objects from prior request keys, each filename, schema, bytes/hash, owner/mode and cross-edge validates under durable_paths, path_key_rule, eexist and retention; no unrelated, malformed, mutable or unresolvable entry is permitted. For the current request, EEXIST handling applies only to the exact target path being created and follows eexist without treating valid retained objects under other request keys as a dirty root. The runtime installation under /opt is immutable and never contains mutable controller state. After acquiring and retaining publication_lock FD34, apply the exact object at /round7_native_wave2_closure/controller/durability/startup_scan in fixed directory/name order, perform a complete mutation-free validation pass; only if no invalid entry exists remove captured legal stale temps in exact order,fsync affected directories,perform a complete mutation-free revalidation pass,and only then classify the current request under /round7_native_wave2_closure/controller/durability/prefix_lattice, and apply /round7_native_wave2_closure/controller/durability/root_poison to every unknown or invalid entry. These requirements augment rather than replace the P00 root/child-directory identity, ownership, mode, mount and retained-final validation above.

startup_scan.classification_rule: Only after a successful complete revalidate-only pass classify the current request under prefix_lattice. Retained finals count only when path-key,schema,bytes/hash,owner/mode and all cross-edges validate. Classification never interleaves with cleanup.
startup_scan.cleanup_rule: CLEANUP runs only when the complete validate-only pass found no persistent invalid entry. Remove only the captured legal stale temps in directory/name order,identity-rechecking before unlink. Fsync each affected directory once after its ordered removals and prove every removed name ENOENT. REVALIDATE_ONLY rescans the complete root,requires every retained final unchanged and no stale or invalid entry,then closes/EBADF-proves every scan FD.
startup_scan.stale_temp_grammar: A legal temp basename is dot + that directory's exact legal final basename + .tmp. + actual positive creator PID without leading zero + dot + actual positive creator /proc/self/stat field22 starttime_ticks without leading zero. Final basenames are exactly 64 lowercase hex plus the directory-specific .json or .bin suffix. No glob,prefix match or PID-liveness inference is allowed.
startup_scan.validation_rule: While holding FD34 enumerate every directory in fixed order and every basename in UTF-8 byte order. VALIDATE_ONLY opens,reads,validates and close/EBADF-proves all required entries but performs literal zero mutation,recording each as valid retained final,legal removable stale temp or persistent invalid. Finish the entire pass even after an invalid observation. If any persistent invalid exists,delete nothing,classify INVALID_PREFIX and fail mutation-free. Unknown name,bad suffix,symlink,hardlink,wrong owner/mode/type/device/nlink,substituted identity or malformed retained final is persistent invalid.

durability.write_algorithm: After the four-phase scan,classify and exact-existing precheck,create the exact sibling temp O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW mode0600,verify creator+inode identity,write complete canonical bytes with positive progress,fdatasync,fsync,then use /round7_native_wave2_closure/controller/durability/ordinary_error_cleanup for every failure and checked close. Renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE),fsync directory,reopen and verify type,owner,mode,nlink,device,size,EOF,schema,hash and FKs. Successful rename enters FINAL_RENAMED and the final is never deleted. No substitute rename,overwrite,truncation,resume or unproved descriptor is allowed.

environment.publisher_security_rule: This exact security context is read back before any derived-G5A CAS lock/mutation. CAS publication completes and every CAS descriptor is close/EBADF-proved before request FD34 or child creation.

external_fd_contract: fd0 is one sealed read-only request memfd at offset zero
fd1 is the sole framed controller-result write pipe
fd2 is an independently opened write-only /dev/null
all other descriptors are closed before controller request parsing
controller.fork_exec: Controller initializes no CPython. It installs all operational targets and FD7 before fork, holds FD34, and constructs exact FD49/50 last. The child uses only async-signal-safe close/fcntl EBADF checks on 32,33,34,48,50, exact read/EOF/close on49, sigprocmask restore and direct execve; failure immediate _exit uses the frozen 125/126 mapping and writes no protocol byte. The parent alone performs PTRACE_SEIZE/INTERRUPT/SYSCALL, signalfd/epoll, wait and publication. vfork,posix_spawn,PATH lookup, untraced exec, child allocation, shell, post-fork dup, retry or an extra process is forbidden. The finite initial syscall resynchronization and attach evidence are mandatory; strict pairing begins immediately afterward.

modes.discover-twin: One request launches two fresh children sequentially. Run0 is fully drained,ptrace-joined and retained only as the exact in-memory provisional discovery row plus process evidence; then the exact monitor inter-run teardown closes/proves48/51/52 and leaves only32/33/34 before run1 fresh construction. No request-level K,final evidence row or attestation exists yet. After run1 joins, construct the two-process K,launch/stream/join indexes and both final v6 rows/attestations, then publish combined indexes. Any post-marker failure is terminal and nonretry.
modes.full-runtime: One controller request launches exactly one child and returns only after the full child stream, EOF, waitpid, final trace, result and durability attestation validate.

address_free_mapping_projection.rule: For file rows compute load bias from map start,file offset and reviewed ELF PT_LOAD; group by exact provider identity and bias; sort instances by provider identity then bias and assign mapping_ordinal. Generate the existing mapping-set fields from provider resolver, exact file offset,mapped_bytes=end-start and permissions. VDSO/vsyscall use exact kernel variants. Use the existing canonical row sort. PREMAIN and terminal projections must byte-equal their respective 0x12 payloads. For each group with nonnull dynamic ordinal, project before/after, compute after-order multiset new_rows, insert the precommitted nonempty primary arrays and serialize the existing eleven-key v5 delta byte-equal to 0x13; flattened transition effects equal the same diff. Null ordinal forbids 0x13. No address,TID or load bias enters BASE.

address_state.kernel_rule: Only one reviewed [vdso] and optional one [vsyscall] from temporac.kernel-runtime-evidence.v6 are legal. VDSO mapped bytes and ELF hash are nonnull and rehash to that evidence. VSYSCALL is allowed only when the evidence mode is emulate or native, permissions are exactly --xp, start is exactly0xffffffffff600000,end exactly0xffffffffff601000,length4096, mapped/ELF hash fields are null, and provider_evidence_sha256 is nonnull and equals the complete kernel-runtime-evidence digest; mode none forbids it. Both rows must be unchanged between initial and terminal sets; any other bracket/kernel row fails.
address_state.memory_read_rule: With every task stopped, process_vm_readv reads every executable interval except the sole kernel-vsyscall variant in ascending address chunks min(1048576,remaining), with positive-progress/EINTR-only retry and exact bounds. File mappings additionally pread the reviewed PT_LOAD file projection and compare all stopped memory bytes byte-for-byte before resume, rejecting private mutation,BSS/anonymous tail,padding inference or provider TOCTOU. VDSO is read; vsyscall follows its exact null-hash exception.

proc_snapshot_fd_contract.rule: Every evidence row has schema temporac.ptrace-proc-snapshot-fd-row.v5 and represents one real open->raw0->dup3->final40/41 lifecycle,never readlinkat. Rows form gap-free snapshot_ordinal groups in physical capture order; every row in a group repeats capture_kind,capture_ordinal,state_ordinal,state_sha256 and has gap-free ordinal; the complete capture tuple is unique. The sole EXEC_BASELINE group selects bootstrap.exec_event_ordinal and state0. Each completed returning transition has exactly one RETURNING_SYSCALL_ENTRY group selecting transition.event_ordinal and its before_state fields and one RETURNING_SYSCALL_EXIT group selecting the same transition ordinal and its after_state fields. A selected syscall terminal leader has exactly one TERMINAL_SYSCALL_ENTRY group selecting its entry event and current terminal state. A SIGNAL_TERMINATION has exactly one SIGNAL_DELIVERY group selecting its signal event and current terminal state. Followers and CONTROLLER_KILL have no capture group. Thus entry/exit remain distinct when a zero-effect transition repeats a state, and no group may be reused,reordered or reassigned. At each group the pre-open parent set is exactly32,33,34,48,51,52 with0..31 absent. PROC_ROOT is ordinal0: openat2 /proc/<pid> returns raw0,promotes40,validates directory/starttime,uses source_token proc-root,null source hash,closes/proves raw0,retains40 through snapshot,then closes/proves40 last. MAPS_READ occurs once after it: maps beneath40 returns raw0,promotes41,uses token maps and complete read+EOF hash,then closes/proves41. PROVIDER_REOPEN rows follow address-row order,open the exact provider raw0->41,use provider:<digest>,hash complete bytes and cross-match device,inode,ELF/provider evidence before close. Raw/final flags resolve the constant ledger; both close errno fields are EBADF. map_files and fd targets use readlinkat beneath40,create no row and feed the corresponding address/provider identity immediately. Missing/extra/reassigned/fabricated group or link row,hidden open,wrong state/trigger/nullability/token/hash,alias,path fallback or incomplete close proof fails.

address_state.projection_rule: Apply address_free_mapping_projection exactly. For file rows derive load bias from start address,file offset and the reviewed PT_LOAD, group only identical provider identity+bias, assign mapping_ordinal by the stated numeric/provider order, and serialize every legacy file row/segment byte-for-byte. Project [vdso] only from its read-and-rehashed kernel evidence. Project [vsyscall] only when the same complete temporac.kernel-runtime-evidence.v6 has mode emulate or native, start exactly0xffffffffff600000,end exactly0xffffffffff601000,permissions --xp,length4096,null mapping hash and nonnull provider digest equal SHA-256 of that complete twelve-key canonical artifact plus LF. Drop addresses only after those checks. PREMAIN/terminal 0x12 bytes and every applicable before/after/0x13 delta are then recomputed under the existing v5 mapping schemas and must be byte-identical; no arbitrary bracket row,alternate grouping or provider-token translation exists.
address_state.row_rule: Rows cover every executable VMA as nonempty page-aligned nonoverlapping half-open intervals and sort numerically by start,end then discriminant fields. File rows are regular, nondeleted, nonmemfd reviewed provider-backed ELF intervals wholly within the exact file-backed executable PT_LOAD range. Apply memory_read_rule before resume and compare the stopped bytes to the exact provider file bytes; private RW mutation before mprotect RX, executable BSS/anonymous tail or inferred padding therefore fails. Existing executable intervals are rechecked when affected. Kernel rows obey the exact variants and remain unchanged. ASLR values are downstream only.

attach_barrier.child_order: The fixed child stub executes raw close34,raw fcntl34/F_GETFD proof,raw close50,raw fcntl50/F_GETFD proof,then raw read49. Exact results are0,EBADF,0,EBADF and these are the only syscalls before the barrier read. Closing/proving50 before the first potentially blocking operation makes a pre-SEIZE parent death produce EOF rather than a self-held pipe; closing/proving34 first releases the inherited flock. After exact one-byte01 completion the child closes/proves32,33,48,requires second read49=EOF,closes49,then while strictly ptrace-paired executes the exact child_credential_drop sequence and parent readback; only after all IDs/capabilities validate does it restore the exact child mask and directly exec. Short/extra/wrong byte,prefix error,unlisted syscall,extra read restart or progress beyond the reviewed stub before registration fails.
attach_barrier.construction: Create one pipe2(O_CLOEXEC) last, promote endpoints to49/50 and validate exact direction,CLOEXEC,blocking,type,OFD,no-alias. FD49/50 are transport-only downstream evidence and absent from launch/carrier rows. Parent retains50 through seize,monitor-fd construction and epoll registration.
attach_barrier.parent_order: Parent closes carrier/targets/49 and verifies only child PID/starttime identity before PTRACE_SEIZE. It PTRACE_SEIZEs with all options,PTRACE_INTERRUPTs and consumes exactly one ATTACH_STOP. While held it reads registers/syscall-info,captures the state-dependent child-FD snapshot and requires one reviewed operation/phase/RIP in the close34,prove34,close50,prove50,read49 stub. SETUP,ENTRY/in-flight and EXIT are closed for every prefix syscall; snapshot presence and any EXIT result agree. Under synchronous PTRACE_SYSCALL/waitpid it consumes the exact remaining successful suffix and holds the task at read49 ENTRY,or retains the already-entered blocked read. Only after child34/50 absence is proved does it construct/register51/52,write one byte01 to50,close50 and complete read resynchronization. This covers every legal parent-first or child-first schedule. Strict ordinary syscall pairs begin only after read completion; no pre-seize register observation,inferred PC or unlisted gap is accepted.

attach_evidence.attach_epoch_rule: attach_epoch is exact temporac.ptrace-attach-epoch.v6. initial_child_fd_snapshot is captured at ATTACH_STOP and selected jointly by initial_operation.operation/phase: CLOSE34 SETUP or ENTRY has mode targets plus32,33,34,48,49,50; CLOSE34 EXIT and every PROVE34 phase omit34 but retain50; CLOSE50 SETUP or ENTRY omits34 and retains50; CLOSE50 EXIT,every PROVE50 phase and every READ phase omit34 and50. No FD snapshot infers a PC. prefix_close_rows is the exact remaining suffix implied by initial operation/phase: SETUP observes current ENTRY+EXIT,ENTRY forbids a fabricated ENTRY and observes current EXIT,and EXIT validates the initial result then starts at the next operation. It ends with child34/50 absent and exact0,EBADF,0,EBADF results. read_resynchronization.initial_state is IN_READ_SYSCALL only for READ ENTRY and otherwise PRE_READ_SETUP after the prefix; PRE_READ_SETUP records the read ENTRY before release. Zero or one reviewed read restart is retained and completion is exactly result1,errno null,byte1. Strict ordinary syscall pairs begin only afterward.

attach_policy_spec.future_rule: child/parent masks resolve the accepted constant-ledger signal_mask_rule. stub_pc_rows is the complete nonempty sorted set described by stub_pc_row_rule,covers exactly every stub_pc_operation_values x stub_pc_phase_values state that is reachable in the fixed stub,and is populated and independently reviewed before BASE. No null,UNASSIGNED,live-learned,caller or partial-PC row is legal.
attach_policy_spec.stub_pc_row_rule: Rows are unique by operation,phase,numeric relative RIP and sorted in that order. For CLOSE34,PROVE34,CLOSE50,PROVE50 and READ,SETUP enumerates every reviewed userspace instruction boundary whose next syscall is that operation; ENTRY is the exact syscall-entry/in-flight boundary; EXIT is the exact post-syscall stop/return boundary. READ EXIT is not an admissible initial state before release; READ ENTRY includes the blocked read. Rows cover every fixed-stub boundary from child fork branch through read return,are nonempty and complete from reviewed disassembly,and bind one supervisor ELF digest. No unlisted gap PC,absolute/ASLR address,live-learned offset,operation/phase mismatch or duplicate is legal.

attach_evidence.barrier_construction_rule: barrier_construction is exact temporac.ptrace-attach-pipe-construction.v5. preconstruction_open_fds is the complete ascending FD set from the immediately-before-pipe fcntl scan. pipe2(O_CLOEXEC) returns raw_read_fd then raw_write_fd as the two lowest absent integers; promote in that order by F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC(min=49) to exact49 and min=50 to exact50, close/prove both raw descriptors, and retain the two endpoint readbacks. Both endpoints have equal nonnegative device/inode/capacity, distinct OFDs, exact O_CLOEXEC, read-only versus write-only access and blocking status. Hidden descriptor, alias, wrong lowest-free result, status mutation or incomplete close proof fails.
attach_evidence.bootstrap_exec_rule: The exact temporac.ptrace-bootstrap-exec.v7 object binds the sole native execve complete six-key syscall_args object and its canonical-LF digest. Top argv_sha256,env_sha256,path_bytes_sha256 and provider_evidence_sha256 byte-equal the same-named nested argv/env/path/executable-provider fields; syscall name/number resolve execve, nested dirfd is null and flags are zero. path_bytes_sha256 also equals SHA-256 of attach_evidence.exec_path exact ASCII bytes, and provider equals attach top exec_provider_evidence_sha256. exec_event_ordinal selects the unique EXEC ptrace row for task0: its nonnull fixed-width event message converts exactly to event_msg_u64, with null signal/epoch/terminal. state0_sha256 equals process state ordinal0 and process.exec_event_state_sha256. After that event the parent resumes once with PTRACE_SYSCALL and consumes the matching post-event exit stop before userspace: post_exec_exit_stop has schema temporac.ptrace-post-exec-exit-stop.v5,kind PTRACE_SYSCALL_EXIT_AFTER_EXEC,result0,errno null and selects exactly one BOOTSTRAP_EXEC_SYSCALL_EXIT event. This special stop creates no returning transition; the next resume begins a fresh ENTRY. Any later exec or mismatched top/nested/event/path/provider/state field fails. credential_drop is the complete temporac.ptrace-child-credential-drop-evidence.v6 object,obeys native_mapping_monitor.child_credential_drop,equates every row to the accepted five-key policy/args variant and reaches the exact all65532/all-cap-zero readback before the exec ENTRY.
attach_evidence.child_fd_snapshot_rule: The object has exactly open_fds,process_ordinal,schema; schema is temporac.ptrace-child-fd-snapshot.v5 and process ordinal matches the request run. A parent-owned stopped scan records the exact ascending mode target set plus32,33,48,49. It additionally contains34 and50 for CLOSE34 SETUP/ENTRY;50 only for CLOSE34 EXIT,all PROVE34 phases and CLOSE50 SETUP/ENTRY;neither for CLOSE50 EXIT,all PROVE50 phases or READ. Snapshot presence agrees with initial operation,phase,EXIT result and reviewed RIP. Missing,extra,duplicate,inconsistent or child-reported state fails.
attach_evidence.digest_rule: ptrace_attach_evidence_sha256 is raw SHA-256 of the complete sixteen-key canonical evidence object+LF and is absent. The top key count remains sixteen; bootstrap_exec is v7 and now contains the complete credential_drop evidence. attach_epoch,bootstrap_exec and monitor_fd_construction recanonicalize; options and masks resolve accepted policy. PID/starttime are downstream integrity only.
attach_evidence.endpoint_readback_rule: Every endpoint object has exactly endpoint_readback_closed_keys and schema temporac.ptrace-pipe-endpoint-readback.v5. Numeric descriptor/status flags resolve the accepted constant ledger; device,inode,capacity,direction and fd cross-match its exact pipe construction. It is constructed from fresh parent fstat/fcntl/readback, never copied from launch prose.
attach_evidence.initial_operation_rule: schema=temporac.ptrace-attach-initial-operation.v5. operation is CLOSE34,CLOSE50,PROVE34,PROVE50 or READ; phase is SETUP,ENTRY or EXIT; state is the exact operation_phase token and the accepted policy row has the same operation/phase/RIP. SETUP has null syscall args,orig_rax,result,errno. ENTRY has exact native syscall number/arguments with null result/errno. EXIT repeats exact args and has close result0/errno null,prove result-1/errno EBADF,or read result fields; READ EXIT before release is forbidden. close args are fd34/50; prove args are fd34/50 and F_GETFD; read args are fd49,count1,exact buffer. PTRACE_GET_SYSCALL_INFO and registers agree; compat/x32 and ambiguous or unlisted states fail.

monitor_fd_construction_spec.rule: Exactly two rows in ordinal order SIGNALFD then EPOLL. Every row schema is temporac.ptrace-monitor-fd-construction-row.v5. Before each creation FD0..31 are absent and the retained open set is exactly preconstruction_open_fds plus any already promoted monitor FD. signalfd4 and epoll_create1 must each return raw FD0; dup3 promotes it to final51 or52 with O_CLOEXEC, exact flags are read back, raw0 is closed and fcntl(F_GETFD) returns EBADF. Numeric future flag/errno fields resolve the accepted runtime constant ledger or fresh fcntl readback; schema/kind/ordinal/raw/final fds are the exact static values. Static and future fields are disjoint and their union equals row_closed_keys.

attach_evidence.prefix_close_rule: Each row is exact temporac.ptrace-attach-prefix-close.v5,sorted by gap-free ordinal and uses operation CLOSE34,PROVE34,CLOSE50 or PROVE50. CLOSE rows have result0/errno null; PROVE rows have result-1/errno EBADF. entry_observed is true when SETUP is resumed and false when initial state was that operation ENTRY. From initial SETUP include current operation and all suffix operations; from ENTRY include current with entry_observed=false plus suffix; from EXIT validate the initial result and begin with the next operation. READ phases have an empty prefix. Exact syscall args are close(fd) or fcntl(fd,F_GETFD); no prefix restart is legal. After the suffix child34/50 are absent before monitor creation or release. Missing,extra,reordered,retried,failed or fabricated operation fails.
attach_evidence.read_resynchronization_rule: schema=temporac.ptrace-attach-read-resynchronization.v6. initial_state is IN_READ_SYSCALL exactly for initial READ ENTRY; otherwise it is PRE_READ_SETUP after exact prefix_close_rows complete and the parent has driven/held exact read(fd49,count1) ENTRY. PRE_READ_SETUP has entry_observed=true; IN_READ_SYSCALL has entry_observed=false and continues the already-entered read. restart_rows length is zero or one; a row has exact closed keys and records only an accepted ERESTART* or EINTR retry including its separately observed re-entry. Final result=1,errno=null,byte=1 and all arguments remain fd49/count1. Wrong state/boolean,a second restart,unmatched unrelated stop or fabricated entry fails.
attach_evidence.rule: FDs are49,50,52,51; pre_exec_stop_kind=PTRACE_EVENT_STOP. signal_mask_hex equals the constant-ledger parent_mask_hex; signalfd uses signalfd_mask_hex and the child later restores child_mask_hex. Attach evidence proves one complete reviewed operation/phase/RIP state,the exact remaining close34/prove34/close50/prove50 suffix,child34/50 absence before monitor creation,the exact read resynchronization,monitor FDs from raw0 after the parent close set,and the unique PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC plus post-event syscall-exit stop before any new-image instruction with non-setid/no-capability/dumpability and exact ELF/provider identity. bootstrap_exec.credential_drop proves the exact ten-call stopped credential prefix and final identity/capability readback before the exec event.

audit_catalog_integration.rule: The future BASE catalog embeds complete reviewed constant ledger,monitor policy,B6 registry and definition provenance. complete_catalog_top_closed_keys byte-equals the effective v8 catalog eleven-key top schema. The embedded B5 objects are byte-for-byte the locally materialized constant_ledger and policy specs, including required-name universe,signal masks,attach policy,dynamic group ordinals and conditional 0x13 semantics; their external digests rehash. Missing provenance pair,old policy shape,partial symbolic table or mirror pointer fails.

child_credential_drop.evidence_rule: The actual temporac.ptrace-child-credential-drop-evidence.v6 has exactly ten gap-free rows: setgroups,setresgid,setresuid,six PR_CAPBSET_DROP calls in numeric capability order,and capset. At each ENTRY and EXIT stop the parent validates the ordinal-specific state in parent_readback; before each PTRACE_SYSCALL resume the next row's exact five-key policy digest,named args object and literal sequence position validate. Successful result is zero/null errno. final_readback is the complete final stopped snapshot. No row is a returning address-state transition or group effect because all occur before bootstrap exec/state0; the exact rows plus final snapshot are nested in bootstrap_exec and hashed by attach evidence.
child_credential_drop.parent_readback: At every named syscall ENTRY and EXIT stop the parent reads the complete identity,groups,securebits,NoNewPrivs and five capability sets and applies this exact ordinal state table. Before/after setgroups: all four UIDs and four GIDs are0,supplementary groups empty,Inh/Amb empty,and Prm/Eff/Bnd equal the exact six capabilities CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE,CAP_KILL,CAP_SETGID,CAP_SETUID,CAP_SETPCAP,CAP_SYS_PTRACE. After setresgid,the four GIDs including fsgid are65532 while four UIDs remain0 and capability sets are unchanged. After setresuid,all eight IDs are65532 and Prm/Eff/Bnd remain the exact six because locked SECBIT_NO_SETUID_FIXUP is continuously verified. For bounding-drop row i in numeric capability order,ENTRY Bnd is the exact six minus the completed prefix and EXIT Bnd additionally removes row i; Prm/Eff remain all six and Inh/Amb remain empty. At capset ENTRY Bnd is empty and Prm/Eff are six; at capset EXIT and completion all IDs are65532,groups empty and Inh/Prm/Eff/Bnd/Amb are empty. NoNewPrivs=1 and the same four locked securebits hold at every state. final_readback and post-exec readback equal only that final capset-EXIT state. Any early final state,capability disappearance outside its ordinal,or readback drift fails while stopped.
child_credential_drop.rule: After barrier byte completion and strict PTRACE_SYSCALL pairing,but before child signal-mask restoration or bootstrap exec,the parent online-validates every exact call and readback under the complete syscall/FD policy. Failure is KERNEL_TRANSITION_MONITOR. The parent retains its own publisher profile; no CAS descriptor exists in the child.
sequence: prctl(PR_CAPBSET_DROP,cap,0,0,0) once for each of CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE,CAP_KILL,CAP_SETGID,CAP_SETUID,CAP_SETPCAP,CAP_SYS_PTRACE in numeric capability order
child_credential_drop.target_identity: The bootstrap executable is non-setuid,non-setgid and has no file capabilities; exec cannot regain any identity or capability.

child_phase_frame.order: PREMAIN_SEAL once. Every initialization/import recipe emits 0x14 ENTER, zero or more parent-observed transitions, then 0x14 EXIT. If and only if its recipe dynamic_load_group_ordinal_or_null is nonnull, exactly one existing 0x13 follows EXIT and matches that group; a null group emits no 0x13. DISPATCH_SEAL occurs once. No nesting,missing/extra phase,wrong owner/group,transition outside an active group or post-seal transition is legal. ENTER initializes the exact recipe cursor; EXIT and PREMAIN_SEAL are accepted only after online exhaustion while the writer remains stopped; no 0x14 frame can retroactively authorize a previously resumed effect.
child_phase_frame.rule: Use the existing FD6/parent-FD48 outer header/checksum. Payload is exact canonical JSON plus LF; one atomic write and complete outer frame are <=PIPE_BUF. 0x14 is control/evidence, not a normalized audit token or origin. Ptrace stops remain parent kernel evidence and are never self-reported by the child.

clone_policy.allowed: Only the exact reviewed Linux x86_64 pthread clone/clone3 forms committed by allowed_clone_recipe_sha256: CLONE_VM|CLONE_SIGHAND|CLONE_THREAD, exit_signal=0, the fixed TLS/parent_tid/child_tid flags and zero reserved/unknown fields. New task is auto-attached and stopped before userspace, receives the next task ordinal and cannot run before registration.
