effective_frame_type_table.0x7e: exactly one temporac.native-child-success.v5 terminal on success
effective_frame_type_table.0x7f: exactly one temporac.native-failure.v5 terminal on failure and forbidden on success

effective_success_order: 0x01 carrier readback after the sole physical-entry FD6 FIONREAD; carrier/process/preinit normalized rows; 0x14 PREMAIN_SEAL; exact 0x12 initial mapping projection

0x02 and normalized row; 0x03 and normalized row; FP/audit setup; initialization 0x14 ENTER; initialization/audit capture; 0x04 and normalized row; 0x05 and config row; raw rows; 0x14 EXIT; emit 0x13 only when the initialization recipe has a nonnull dynamic-load ordinal; then normalized rows

For each explicit import recipe: 0x14 ENTER, causal raw rows, 0x14 EXIT, exactly one 0x13 iff its dynamic-load ordinal is nonnull, then normalized rows. Empty transition recipes with null dynamic ordinal emit no 0x13.
0x14 DISPATCH_SEAL; one 0x20 or0x21; finalization raw/normalized rows with zero executable transition; terminal 0x12; 0x7e; EOF; exit_group(0)
b5_kernel_transition_monitor.event_loop: Parent blocks SIGCHLD before fork; child restores the accepted mask only after barrier close. FD48 alone is nonblocking and FD6 remains blocking. After ATTACH_STOP construct51/52,promote/register signalfd and FD48 before release50. Each loop drains48 to EAGAIN,waitpid(-1,__WALL|WNOHANG) to empty,then epoll_wait without timeout; signalfd readiness drains records and repeats wait drain. Before every PTRACE_SYSCALL resume exactly one ordinary gate or one four-row whole-span FUTEX gate validates the available prefix. During cooperation the gate arrays distinguish the in-kernel waiter from a held EXIT; the first wait/wake EXIT stays held. Blocking controller reads,busy poll,gate bypass,unprofiled gap or userspace resume before validation fails.

evidence_integration.publication: Parent publishes the exact transition index under traces/<sha256>.json through B2 while FD34 is held, after join evidence J and before full trace T/result U. The traces directory schema union is exactly executable-origin-trace.v6 or kernel-transition-index.v7. All downstream references resolve complete retained bytes and cross-match request,launch,process,policy,phase frames,0x12/0x13 mapping evidence and terminal state. No prelaunch/BASE object contains the actual index digest.

failure_cleanup.algorithm: First failure wins. At the failure epoch freeze an exact sorted set of currently live task ordinals; already-terminal tasks retain their previously observed exact wait status and are never reclassified. Retain FD34,48,51,52 until every failure-epoch live task is terminal. Close barrier writer/aliases, send kill(leader,SIGKILL) with EINTR retry (ESRCH only with prior terminal leader evidence), and resume every stopped live task only with PTRACE_SYSCALL(tid,0,SIGKILL); consume/classify any intermediate syscall or PTRACE_EVENT_EXIT stop and continue only with PTRACE_SYSCALL(tid,0,0), then loop waitpid(-1,__WALL) to ECHILD. Every failure-epoch live task must end WIFSIGNALED/SIGKILL; tasks terminal before the epoch keep their exact prior status. Never PTRACE_CONT,detach or publish PASS K. Drain/close48/51/52,clean exact durability temps under34,close/release34,restore32/33 and emit the frozen error. Tracee policy failure exits122; parent monitor infrastructure failure exits123. If kill/reap itself is unrecoverable rely on PTRACE_O_EXITKILL,emit no byte and exit124 immediately.
failure_cleanup.failure_epoch_rule: The immutable failure-epoch live set is derived from the already retained task and terminal-event state at the first failure, before any kill. Membership,prior-terminal status and subsequent waits are complete and gap-free; cleanup cannot enlarge the set,overwrite the first stage or demand SIGKILL for a task already terminal.

failure_mapping.rule: KERNEL_TRANSITION_MONITOR covers attach,resync,syscall/task,address/provider,phase/group,stop-world and cleanup violations after fork. Tracee violations follow exit122; parent monitor infrastructure follows123; unrecoverable kill/reap emits no bytes and124. Pre-seize fork stays FORK, target exec identity stays EXEC, and first stage is never overwritten. This is a failure-stage token only, not a seventeenth normalized token or fourteenth origin.

fd_and_path_state.row_rule: Rows sort by FD and cover every open tracee FD exactly once. State0 derives from exact launch rows and accepted OFD equivalence classes. Raw proc-link bytes,fdinfo flags/pos,fstat identity/type and provider evidence are read with all tasks stopped. ofd_offset_u64_or_null is nonnull exactly for seekable regular/directory descriptions,null for nonseekable/PATH_ONLY descriptions,and equal across every alias of one ofd_ordinal. A precommitted regular/directory input has nonnull provider evidence. Open allocates a fresh OFD/offset; dup aliases it; replacement is atomic; READ/READV advance by verified result; GETDENTS/64 set the verified EXIT cookie; LSEEK sets result; PREAD variants do not advance; close removes. Errors preserve semantic state. Hidden FD,flag,OFD,offset or provider change fails.
fd_and_path_state.state_rule: FD state ordinal0 is complete after bootstrap. Every returning transition consumes ordinal n and produces n+1,including errors and semantic no-ops. All aliases carry the same OFD offset. Each state digest hashes the complete canonical temporac.tracee-fd-state.v7 object plus LF. len(fd_states)=len(returning transition rows)+1; every transition before/after ordinal/hash/output FK is exact and every offset change is justified by its decoded result.

index.digest_rule: kernel_transition_index_sha256 is raw SHA-256 of the complete closed canonical index bytes including LF and is absent from the object. All strings are NFC; hashes lowercase; integers exact; addresses/bitmasks fixed-width lowercase 0x hex; no float, duplicate/extra key, self-zeroing digest or alternate serialization.
index.process_rule: Full requests have one process0; discovery has process0,1. Each process has one closed attach/bootstrap and gap-free ptrace,phase,transition,address,FD,task,stop-world,proc-snapshot,futex and terminal arrays with exact identity/state/status FKs. Every ordinary returning syscall resolves one RETURNING_TRANSITION epoch and one output/FD-state edge. Each equal-value profiled FUTEX pair resolves exactly one cooperation,one whole-span FUTEX_COOPERATION epoch and two consecutive transitions/states; immediate-EAGAIN WAIT and standalone WAKE remain ordinary. Group effects and group/null-gap FUTEX profiles are verified online and exhausted at phase boundaries. No runtime output,uaddr,outcome,epoch or K digest enters policy/BASE. Each terminal row's clear-TID evidence is complete and ordered after its PTRACE_EVENT_EXIT/final-wait edge while peers remain stopped; robust-list state is proven empty.
index.top_rule: contract,request,mode,monitor policy and the request-mode process array cross-match. controller_request_sha256 resolves one durable exact request; each process launch_instance_sha256 resolves the same-position durable launch-evidence row, with one full row or two discovery rows. monitor_policy_sha256 resolves the accepted BASE catalog policy. This one request-level temporac.kernel-transition-index.v8 K object is published once and its digest is repeated by the request durability attestation and each applicable discovery row; each row selects exactly its own process_ordinal. No PID,address,TID,index digest enters BASE.

b5_kernel_transition_monitor.monotonic_policy: The success state is executable-VMA monotonic. At syscall entry reject any operation that can remove X, move/replace an executable interval, remove execute permission, overlap it with MAP_FIXED*, create W+X, create anonymous/memfd/deleted/unresolved executable memory, execute SHM, or mutate executable bytes through /proc/*/mem, process_vm_writev or an unmodelled path. A new executable interval is allowed only for the exact reviewed regular-file ELF/provider segment and its mapped bytes/offset/permissions. At syscall exit validate the complete stopped state before any constructor or other task resumes. Thus load then execute then unload cannot escape: additions are validated before execution and later executable removal is forbidden. The complete FD/path state independently rejects every direct,vectored,asynchronous or aliased executable-byte write and the ordered recipe cursor rejects a valid effect in the wrong group/order before resume.

policy.architecture_values_and_resolvers: Architecture literals and syscall table digest resolve the complete accepted constant ledger. the future attach_barrier value is governed by attach_barrier_spec and signal_policy is the exact closed static value; masks,options,stub PCs and numeric values resolve ledger rows. constant_ledger_sha256 hashes the complete inline ledger, supervisor_elf_sha256 resolves the installed build output, and no unresolved symbolic authority remains.

attach_barrier_spec.future_rule: child/parent masks resolve the accepted constant-ledger signal_mask_rule. stub_pc_rows is the complete nonempty sorted set described by stub_pc_row_rule,covers exactly every stub_pc_operation_values x stub_pc_phase_values state that is reachable in the fixed stub,and is populated and independently reviewed before BASE. No null,UNASSIGNED,live-learned,caller or partial-PC row is legal.
attach_barrier_spec.stub_pc_row_rule: Rows are unique by operation,phase,numeric relative RIP and sorted in that order. For CLOSE34,PROVE34,CLOSE50,PROVE50 and READ,SETUP enumerates every reviewed userspace instruction boundary whose next syscall is that operation; ENTRY is the exact syscall-entry/in-flight boundary; EXIT is the exact post-syscall stop/return boundary. READ EXIT is not an admissible initial state before release; READ ENTRY includes the blocked read. Rows cover every fixed-stub boundary from child fork branch through read return,are nonempty and complete from reviewed disassembly,and bind one supervisor ELF digest. No unlisted gap PC,absolute/ASLR address,live-learned offset,operation/phase mismatch or duplicate is legal.

digest_rules.group_recipe: recipe_sha256 hashes the exact standalone group recipe row after deleting only recipe_sha256, canonical JSON plus LF. expected_transition_rows have exactly after_permissions_or_null,before_permissions_or_null,effect_length_bytes,file_offset_bytes_or_null,operation,provider_evidence_sha256_or_null,transition_ordinal and sort by gap-free transition_ordinal.
digest_rules.monitor_policy: kernel_transition_monitor_policy_sha256 hashes the exact complete closed policy object canonical bytes plus LF and is external to that object.
digest_rules.state: state_sha256 hashes decoded complete temporac.executable-address-state.v6 canonical bytes plus LF; state_bytes_hex decodes to those exact bytes and recanonicalizes bytewise.
digest_rules.syscall_args: syscall_args_sha256 hashes the complete per-syscall closed args object canonical bytes plus LF.

policy.futex_profile_rule: Each group recipe carries a literal expected_futex_cooperations array sorted by gap-free futex_profile_ordinal. Two identical P06 runs freeze only equal-value PRIVATE WAIT/WAKE pairs: group effect cursor,distinct deterministic tasks,exact commands,expected/count and identical normalized nonzero bitsets. Runtime virtual addresses are excluded from BASE; the pair requires one aligned runtime uaddr equal in both args and accepted same-mm nonexecutive writable memory. For a group cooperation group_ordinal_or_null and recipe_cursor_or_null are both nonnull: the group selects the active ENTER,recipe_cursor equals its committed effect cursor,and futex_profile_ordinal equals the current group futex cursor and selects that exact row. A group consumes profiles strictly in order and exhausts them at EXIT; null-group pairs use expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations. Nothing is learned from authority runs.
policy.group_recipe_rule: group_recipes are nonempty and gap-free in the frozen pre-main,CPython initialization and import-plan order. expected_transition_rows and expected_futex_cooperations may be empty. At ENTRY the exact policy,args,before states,group and committed effect/futex cursors are checked; at EXIT actual ordered effects byte-match the next expected rows and commit before userspace. Equal-value blocking FUTEX consumes exactly one static group or null-gap profile through the four-gate whole-span epoch,with the group/recipe fields both nonnull or both null as defined and futex_profile_cursor_before equal to the selected profile ordinal. Group EXIT and every phase boundary require exact effect/profile exhaustion; no effect or cooperation is learned from twins.
policy.policy_row_digest_rule: Every transition policy_row_sha256 hashes the unique exact five-key v6 syscall-table row canonical bytes plus LF. Its action selects exactly one closed args variant. ENTRY_TO_EXIT validates the row,args,before states and committed online prefix; EXIT_TO_USERSPACE validates complete after FD/path/address/output evidence and commits actual ordered effects before userspace. A FUTEX cooperation binds the next static group or ungrouped profile before its first resume.

signal_policy.rule: Any signal-delivery or group stop on a PASS path fails closed and is never reinjected. During controller failure cleanup only SIGKILL may be injected exactly as the cleanup algorithm states; no other child signal policy or live disposition is accepted.

entry_reject_rows: MAP_FIXED or MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE overlap with executable VMA
all unmodeled file data,metadata,xattr,sync,lock,IPC,socket,signal,timer,scheduler,resource,namespace,module,keyring and tracing mutations
any executable-range removal,move,replace or permission loss
fork,vfork,exec after the sole target exec,namespace or untraced clone

fd_path_policy.open_rule: open/openat/openat2 decode bounded NUL-terminated raw path bytes at ENTRY and reject write/read-write access,O_CREAT,O_TRUNC,O_APPEND,O_TMPFILE,unsupported flags,nonzero reserved/trailing open_how bytes or alternate-root resolution. Any successful regular/provider FD is read-only and receives a fresh OFD ordinal. Every successful path must resolve one precommitted read-only input/provider role; /proc/*/mem,magic,device,unreviewed filesystem and mutable alias opens fail even with read-only flags.
fd_path_policy.read_and_query_rule: READ/PREAD64/READV/PREADV/PREADV2 use only tracked read-only precommitted provider/input FDs or exact DEV_NULL. ENTRY fixes every destination,iovec,count,offset and flags; preadv2 requires flags0 and explicit nonnegative offset,so offset -1 rejects. EXIT before userspace captures every written byte and compares it to the provider slice. READ/READV advance shared OFD offset; PREAD variants do not. LSEEK permits only tracked seekable regular/directory FDs,SEEK_SET/CUR and a nonnegative result and atomically sets every alias offset. GETDENTS/64 parse their bound ABI records against the complete precommitted directory projection and set the shared directory cookie from EXIT evidence. ACCESS forbids W_OK; every path,dirfd,flag,metadata,credential,cwd,symlink,resource,affinity,kernel and output identity resolves an existing authority object and cannot be learned from runtime. The sole ioctl(FD6,FIONREAD) additionally binds result_pointer_u64_hex at ENTRY and a four-byte FD_QUERY output at EXIT; its u32 value is zero and cross-matches the physical-entry carrier row.
fd_path_policy.rule: The complete max471 table deterministically partitions385 assigned names into375 required and10 exact reviewed scalar register-only names. The required set partitions into303 entry rejects and72 decoded variants. decoded_fd_syscalls is the exact decoded FD/path/pointer-output subset. All direct,vectored,asynchronous,namespace,metadata,random,queue-consuming and indirect executable-byte writers not given a closed decoder reject at ENTRY. The seven selector-bearing getpgid,getpriority,getsid,ioprio_get,kcmp,sched_getscheduler and timer_getoverrun calls and rseq are literal ENTRY_REJECT_REGS6 rows; none may use REVIEWED_PASSTHROUGH or a decoded fallback. The only ioctl is exact FD6 FIONREAD. Open/dup/fcntl/close/write,all A29 reader/query calls,the conservative sys_ni rejects and every numeric tail row have one unique action/variant. Omission,extra name,wrong max or REVIEWED substitution fails before BASE.
fd_path_policy.syscall_output_contract_rule: Rows are ASCII syscall_name sorted and unique. Their33 names and the sorted39 syscall_output_none_names are disjoint and their union is exactly the72 DECODE_AND_VALIDATE names. Every row args_variant is the unique constant-ledger variant. Each destination_templates array is template_ordinal sorted and uses only an exact token in syscall_output_contract_token_grammar; ARG/EACH fields must exist in that variant,LAYOUT names must resolve one required UAPI row,and all true destinations are nonoverlapping accepted writable nonexecutive memory. At matched EXIT before userspace,result_i64 and the selected result/length/cardinality rules determine the exact destination count/order and bytes. The output kind,source digest and source offset must match the selected literal row. A none-name is permitted only when its complete allowed variant performs no tracee-memory output at that return; any UAPI-possible write makes that variant ENTRY_REJECT. Conditional zero-destination rows emit null and prove no write. Clone/clone3 use the fixed parent/child-TID flags; rseq is not in either set and rejects at ENTRY. No runtime output may select or widen a row,grammar token,layout,source or offset.
fd_path_policy.write_rule: write/writev may resume only when the before-FD-state role is FD6_FRAME_PIPE or DEV_NULL. FD6 bytes equal one exact already-framed stream write and total is <=PIPE_BUF; provider,regular/block/proc-mem or other write-capable FD fails. MAP_SHARED providers and executable mapping from a write-capable FD reject. FD6 may not be replaced,duplicated,imported or flag-mutated. It may be closed exactly once only after the child has successfully written its complete accepted terminal 0x7e or 0x7f frame and will emit no later byte: close args must name6,result0/null errno,the strict after FD-state removes6,no later transition references6,and the parent drains the complete frame then observes EOF before accepting terminal wait. Any premature/error/duplicate close or missing EOF fails. Its sole read-side FIONREAD remains the physical-entry call.

online_recipe_prefix.cursor_rule: Each group expected_transition_rows array and group/null-gap FUTEX profile array has exact gap-free ordinals. ENTER activates the next group with effect and group-futex cursors0; null gaps use the global ungrouped cursor and exact surrounding frame FKs. A cooperation requires the group/recipe selectors both nonnull or both null,profile ordinal equal to the selected current cursor,and after=before+1 only at atomic G3. At a returning EXIT while all tasks remain stopped,flatten actual effects in the fixed order and byte-compare every row with the next expected prefix before committing. Underflow,overflow,wrong group/order/multiplicity/provider/permissions/offset,duplicate effect or profile mismatch fails with prior cursors retained.
online_recipe_prefix.effect_sort_rule: While all tasks remain stopped flatten all effects and sort by numeric start,end,operation UTF-8,null-before-string provider,permissions and file offset. effect_length_bytes=end-start and projected transition_ordinal=cursor+i. No set-only comparison or post-resume validation is allowed.
online_recipe_prefix.expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations_ru: The future policy expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations array is globally gap-free by futex_profile_ordinal and sorted in execution order. Each row is the same static wait/wake recipe as a group profile plus exact after/before phase-frame ordinal FKs delimiting one null-group gap; post-DISPATCH uses after=DISPATCH_SEAL and before=null. A null-group cooperation consumes exactly the next row. Every ENTER,PREMAIN_SEAL,DISPATCH_SEAL and terminal boundary proves the just-ended gap exhausted. Runtime uaddr,outcome,epoch,state and K digest never enter this BASE array; two P06 runs must produce byte-identical rows,including an exact empty array when no such pair exists.
online_recipe_prefix.phase_rule: PREMAIN_SEAL and every EXIT require exact current group effect/futex exhaustion. Every ENTER,PREMAIN_SEAL,DISPATCH_SEAL and terminal boundary also proves the preceding ungrouped profile gap exhausted. DISPATCH_SEAL forbids later executable effect but may be followed only by its explicitly precommitted null-group FUTEX rows. Missing,extra,nested,misordered or unexhausted group/gap fails before userspace.
online_recipe_prefix.resume_rule: Every PTRACE_SYSCALL resume selects exactly one closed gate. ENTRY_TO_EXIT validates the five-key policy row,closed args,before FD/path/address/provider state,the exact syscall-output contract and current ordered recipe prefix,then resumes only the initiator to the matched EXIT; no unavailable after-state is fabricated at ENTRY. CLONE_EVENT_TO_EXIT retains the same reservation through the intermediate clone event. EXIT_TO_USERSPACE captures result/errno,contract-selected output destinations,after FD/OFD/path/address/provider state and ordered effects,then atomically commits state/effect/profile cursors before any userspace resume. Equal-value PRIVATE FUTEX uses the four-gate whole-span cooperation epoch and requires the stopped WAKE-entry word to differ from the wait expected value before G2; immediate mismatch EAGAIN and standalone WAKE use ordinary gates. Zero/multiple gates,wrong static group/null-gap profile or cursor,early userspace,missing release observation or unvalidated output fails while stopped.

syscall_policy.resolver_rule: allowed_clone_recipe_sha256 equals constant_ledger.clone_recipe_sha256. The complete bound max471 table has exactly385 assigned names: required_syscall_rows is exactly375 and reviewed_passthrough_rows exactly10. entry_reject_syscalls is exactly303; the other72 required rows are DECODE_AND_VALIDATE with one named variant. The 15 obsolete sys_ni names,the seven selector-bearing former passthroughs and rseq are included in the rejects. The ten reviewed rows are exactly getegid,geteuid,getgid,getpgrp,getpid,getppid,gettid,getuid,sched_get_priority_max,sched_get_priority_min; they take no pointer,FD,path or external task selector,return only through registers and use REVIEWED_REGS6. Every decoded row name,number,class,action,variant,args and policy digest cross-matches. Missing,extra,duplicate,cross-action,pointer-bearing or selector-bearing passthrough,or generic-register substitution fails.

policy.ungrouped_futex_profile_rule: The future policy expected_ungrouped_futex_cooperations array is globally gap-free by futex_profile_ordinal and sorted in execution order. Each row is the same static wait/wake recipe as a group profile plus exact after/before phase-frame ordinal FKs delimiting one null-group gap; post-DISPATCH uses after=DISPATCH_SEAL and before=null. For a null-group cooperation group_ordinal_or_null and recipe_cursor_or_null are both null; futex_profile_ordinal equals the current global ungrouped cursor and the row's frame FKs exactly bracket the current gap. Every ENTER,PREMAIN_SEAL,DISPATCH_SEAL and terminal boundary proves the just-ended gap exhausted. Runtime uaddr,outcome,epoch,state and K digest never enter this BASE array; two P06 runs must produce byte-identical rows,including an exact empty array when no such pair exists.

b5_kernel_transition_monitor.stop_the_world: At any watched ENTRY the initiator remains stopped while every other live task is placed in its exact pending/interrupted/carried state. Ordinary ENTRY resumes only the initiator to the matched EXIT; clone children remain frozen through the intermediate event. Equal-value PRIVATE FUTEX instead creates one whole-span epoch: only waiter then one statically selected waker may run through the four exact gates,both EXITs are held,and both zero-effect transitions/states commit together before userspace. Any task escape,unknown stop,wrong priority,unprofiled peer,early output or incomplete stop set fails.

syscall_args.clone_rule: For legacy clone, clone3_size,set_tid_size,stack_size,cgroup,pidfd are null, set_tid/trailing bytes are empty, and stack/flags/parent_tid/child_tid/tls/exit signal come from the six native registers. For clone3, read exactly size bytes at ENTRY while stop-world, require size within the bound UAPI struct range, decode every named field, retain exact set_tid bytes and size, and require every unknown/reserved/trailing byte zero. The normalized object must match exactly one constant-ledger pthread form; stack is nonzero and aligned, stack_size positive for clone3, exit_signal=0. No inferred or omitted stack/size/tail field is accepted. The fixed pthread form has nonnull parent_tid and child_tid with CLONE_PARENT_SETTID,CLONE_CHILD_SETTID and CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID; return-output captures both initial PID_T writes and terminal-memory evidence captures the child clear.
syscall_args.exec_rule: The sole bootstrap call is native execve, never execveat: dirfd_i32_or_null is null and flags_u64_hex is fixed-width zero. argv_sha256 and env_sha256 hash the exact closed launcher arrays; path_bytes_sha256 hashes the fixed ASCII executable path bytes without NUL; executable_provider_evidence_sha256 resolves the installed supervisor ELF. Any later execve/execveat is rejected by policy. No pathname alias,AT_FDCWD inference,flags substitution or digest-only top/nested mismatch is accepted.
syscall_args.extended_stateful_rule: ARCH_PRCTL accepts only the preflight exact ARCH_SET_FS and nonexecutive-output ARCH_GET_FS forms. BRK and MADVISE cross-check executable-address state; MADVISE rejects executable overlap and every unlisted advice. MEMBARRIER accepts only QUERY,REGISTER_PRIVATE_EXPEDITED and PRIVATE_EXPEDITED. PRLIMIT64 requires pid0,a null new-limit pointer/bytes and query-only output into accepted nonexecutive writable memory. RESTART_SYSCALL is exact empty {} and exists only as the unique continuation of a retained ERESTART_RESTARTBLOCK operation; direct user invocation fails. RSEQ registration/unregistration is an exact ENTRY reject because its notify-resume user-area writes are not observable by the chosen pure PTRACE_SYSCALL gate before userspace. RT_SIGACTION,RT_SIGPROCMASK and SIGALTSTACK read exact input bytes at ENTRY,validate output targets as accepted nonexecutive writable memory and maintain complete per-task disposition/mask/altstack chains; PASS permits no delivered signal. SCHED_SETAFFINITY targets self or one accepted live TID and equals the frozen preflight mask. SET_ROBUST_LIST and SET_TID_ADDRESS pointers lie in that task's accepted nonexecutive writable mapping. PERSONALITY accepts only persona=0x00000000ffffffff and requires EXIT to equal the bound PER_LINUX value; every setting form rejects. Unknown command,flag,reserved/trailing byte,pointer nullability or state/result mismatch fails. SET_ROBUST_LIST accepts only a fully read exact empty self-linked robust_list_head with null pending entry and frozen futex offset,and that head is reread unchanged at every later stop. SET_TID_ADDRESS and the fixed clone child-TID form maintain one final per-task clear-TID pointer,which is closed only by terminal-memory evidence after final wait.
syscall_args.futex_rule: FUTEX decodes the command after masking only the bound PRIVATE flag; CLOCK_REALTIME,PI,requeue,external/shared-mm,timeout and every unlisted form fail. A WAIT or WAIT_BITSET has a null timeout pointer/bytes and exact expected value/bitset; a WAKE or WAKE_BITSET has count1 and exact bitset. The uaddr is aligned and lies in accepted nonexecutive writable memory shared only by this traced CLONE_VM task set. At WAIT ENTRY the stopped parent reads the exact u32. If it differs from expected,the ordinary ENTRY_TO_EXIT gate is used and the only accepted result is -EAGAIN with no cooperation. If equal,the next unconsumed precommitted cooperation profile must identify one distinct live waker task before the waiter resumes; the closed cooperation gate then applies. Standalone precommitted WAKE and immediate mismatch WAIT remain ordinary zero-effect transitions.
syscall_args.reader_and_query_rule: READV/PREADV/PREADV2 iov_count equals len(iov_rows),capacities sum to total_capacity_bytes,and ordered pointer ranges are bounded,nonoverlapping accepted writable nonexecutive mappings. All path bytes use the existing bounded NUL/root/dirfd/symlink resolver; raw path bytes and digest are exact. Every output pointer/capacity is frozen at ENTRY and every byte written is captured at the matched EXIT before userspace. ACCESS modes/AT flags,clock IDs,stat masks,UAPI layouts,credentials,resources,affinity and directory record formats resolve the v7 constant ledger. GETTIMEOFDAY timezone is null; SCHED_GETAFFINITY pid is0/self; CAPGET is current process and the frozen empty-capability state. Unknown pointer,flag,mask,layout,padding,target,result or output write fails.
syscall_args.rule: Each syscall row args_variant selects exactly one object defined here. Normalize exact registers and every bounded pointed input at the stopped ENTRY; hash canonical args plus LF and verify registers,memory,args and the five-key policy row. Returning REVIEWED_PASSTHROUGH is only one of the exact10 scalar policy names and uses REVIEWED_REGS6; REJECT uses ENTRY_REJECT_REGS6 and never resumes. The72 decoded names use their unique named projections,including all A29 pointer/FD/path readers. No pointer,FD,path or task selector is first dereferenced after resume,no generic six-register fallback satisfies a decoded/rejected name,and unavailable,short,racing or noncanonical input fails.
syscall_args.variant_rule: All *_u64_hex fields are fixed-width lowercase0x plus16 hex digits. REVIEWED_REGS6 and ENTRY_REJECT_REGS6 are exact six-register objects with disjoint actions. Open paths,write buffers and existing stateful projections retain their prior exact semantics. The A29 arrays are closed exactly as listed; read iov rows preserve kernel order. Output pointers are validated at ENTRY and complete syscall-output evidence is constructed at EXIT. PREADV2 flags must0 and offset nonnegative. FD6/DEV_NULL writes retain their exact write/terminal-close rules. Unknown/extra/missing key,width,result,action or variant fails.

tasks_and_transitions.clone_intermediate_rule: PTRACE_EVENT_CLONE is an intermediate event, never the clone syscall EXIT. At the event stop record the exact new TID, collect and classify its mandatory CLONE_CHILD_STOP, allocate the next task ordinal and retain the child frozen; then resume only the initiator with PTRACE_SYSCALL until the real matched syscall-exit stop supplies result/errno for the transition. Only after address-state/effect/clone-recipe validation may the epoch resume order include the child. Treating event-msg as syscall result or letting the child run first fails.
tasks_and_transitions.errno_rule: result_i64 is the signed native return from the paired EXIT. Values -4095..-1 set errno_or_null to the positive negation; nonnegative sets null. Kernel restart pseudo-errors are never serialized: the exact restart/entry/exit sequence must resolve to one completed syscall or fail. Any other negative encoding, errno on success, or bool/overflow fails.
tasks_and_transitions.final_wait_rule: Every wait object has schema temporac.ptrace-terminal-wait.v5 and is the exact final waitpid(__WALL) status. WIFEXITED has exit_status_or_null in0..255,null signal and raw_status_u32 that decodes to that status; WIFSIGNALED has null exit status,a positive accepted terminal signal and a raw status decoding to that signal. SYSCALL_EXIT/SYSCALL_EXIT_GROUP require WIFEXITED and exit_status_or_null=(status_u32 & 255). EXIT_GROUP_FOLLOWER byte-equals the leader final_wait. SIGNAL_TERMINATION requires WIFSIGNALED and the same signal as its selected SIGNAL_DELIVERY event. CONTROLLER_KILL requires WIFSIGNALED/SIGKILL. Stopped/continued,core/status disagreement,ambiguous or reconstructed status fails.
tasks_and_transitions.futex_cooperation_rule: futex_cooperations sort by gap-free cooperation_ordinal. An equal-value PRIVATE WAIT ENTRY requires wait_observed_u32=wait_expected_u32 and creates one whole-span FUTEX_COOPERATION epoch whose initiator remains wait_task and whose sole selector is this cooperation. It consumes exactly the next static group profile or,when group_ordinal_or_null and recipe_cursor_or_null are both null,the next phase-bracketed ungrouped profile. In group mode both fields are nonnull and select the active group/effect cursor. futex_profile_ordinal equals the selected row and current futex_profile_cursor_before; futex_profile_cursor_after=before+1 and is committed only at G3. Wait/wake use the same aligned same-mm nonexecutive writable uaddr; timeout is null; no signal,restart,external actor,PI,requeue/waitv is allowed; count is1. Plain operations normalize MATCH_ANY; BITSET values are nonzero and exactly equal. G0 seals effect/profile cursors and zero-effect before/intermediate/after FD/address reservations without publishing. The selected waker's next ENTRY is the matching WAKE or fails before kernel execution. At that stopped WAKE ENTRY the parent rereads the same uaddr,stores the exact current u32 as wake_observed_u32 and requires wake_observed_u32!=wait_expected_u32 before G2 may resume the waker; with every other actor stopped this is the mandatory visible release-store condition that prevents a WAKE-before-enqueue lost wake. EXITs may arrive in either order and the first is held. Only (wait0,wake1) or (wait-EAGAIN,wake0) is accepted. G3 atomically materializes two consecutive transitions/states,keeps the effect cursor unchanged,advances the selected futex cursor once and only then resumes. Immediate entry-word mismatch consumes no profile/cooperation and must return EAGAIN via ordinary gates. Both transitions and the cooperation point to the same unique stop_world_epoch_ordinal; reverse FKs are bijective. Failure discards the unpublished reservation and K has no hole. The selected static row's eight wait/wake fields byte-equal the cooperation; group_ordinal_or_null is null iff recipe_cursor_or_null is null. In group mode the active group,its effect cursor and selected profile recipe_cursor byte-equal recipe_cursor_or_null; in null mode the global row's phase-frame brackets byte-equal the current gap. futex_profile_ordinal=futex_profile_cursor_before=selected profile ordinal and futex_profile_cursor_after=before+1; both transitions repeat the group/recipe/epoch FKs and reverse profile/cooperation/epoch/transition relations are bijective.
tasks_and_transitions.futex_gate_rule: Each cooperation has exactly four gate_rows with ordinal0..3 and gate values WAIT_ENTRY_TO_KERNEL,PEER_USERSPACE_TO_WAKE_ENTRY,WAKE_ENTRY_TO_KERNEL,PAIR_EXIT_TO_USERSPACE. Every task array is sorted,unique and exact. G0 trigger=wait,resume=[wait],pending/held empty,stopped=live-minus-wait and observed_u32_or_null=wait_observed_u32=wait_expected_u32. G1 trigger=null,resume=[waker],wait appears in exactly one of kernel-pending or held-exit,stopped=all other live tasks,observed null; waker begins at a proved userspace-boundary stop with no pending syscall,terminal,clone or event and its next ENTRY must be the exact profile WAKE. At that ENTRY,while still stopped,G2 observed_u32_or_null=wake_observed_u32 is read from the same uaddr and must differ from wait_expected_u32; equality fails before the WAKE executes. G2 trigger=wake,resume=[waker] only after that inequality,with the same wait pending-XOR-held partition and all others stopped. G3 trigger=the second observed EXIT,pending empty,held exact task-sorted wait+wake,stopped remaining live tasks,observed null,and resume equals the epoch final resume set or empty while older pending-entry priority drains. No task is omitted,duplicated or runnable in two classes.
tasks_and_transitions.phase_wrapper_rule: frame_ordinal is the exact FD48 outer-frame sequence. payload_sha256 hashes row canonical bytes plus LF; row is the exact eight-key temporac.kernel-transition-phase.v5 payload and its launch/policy/group/owner fields match active process/policy recipe. Wrappers sort by frame ordinal and obey PREMAIN_SEAL, ENTER/EXIT, DISPATCH_SEAL state machine.
tasks_and_transitions.ptrace_event_rule: Ptrace event ordinals are gap-free,use exactly ptrace_event_kind_values and are distinct from syscall/frame/state ordinals. Every event task_ordinal selects exactly one enclosing task row and kernel_tid equals that row kernel_tid. ATTACH_STOP occurs once for task0. ATTACH_STOP,BOOTSTRAP_EXEC_SYSCALL_EXIT and CLONE_CHILD_STOP have null message,signal and stop-world epoch. STOP_WORLD_INTERRUPT has null message/signal and nonnull epoch referenced by INTERRUPTED_NOW or later CARRIED_EVENT_STOP. TERMINAL_SYSCALL_ENTRY has null message/signal/terminal object,nonnull eventual active terminal epoch and is selected by exactly one SYSCALL_EXIT or SYSCALL_EXIT_GROUP terminal row; it may be referenced as PENDING_TERMINAL_ENTRY by earlier epochs without cancellation. EXEC has nonnull message,task0,null signal/epoch/terminal and is selected by bootstrap.exec_event_ordinal; fixed-width hex converts to bootstrap.event_msg_u64. CLONE has nonnull new-TID message,null signal/terminal and binds one task row. SIGNAL_DELIVERY has null message,nonnull accepted signal,null epoch and a terminal object only for SIGNAL_TERMINATION. TASK_EXIT/PROCESS_EXIT have nonnull message equal terminal.final_wait.raw_status_u32,null signal/epoch and byte-identical nonnull terminal object; PROCESS_EXIT is only last task. PTRACE_EVENT_STOP is retained only in declared stop kinds. BOOTSTRAP exit cross-matches post_exec_exit_stop. Fork/vfork/seccomp,unknown event,task/TID mismatch,wrong nullability,width/conversion or ambiguous stop fails.
tasks_and_transitions.state_wrapper_rule: ordinal0 has stage EXEC_BASELINE and null group. Later state changes have stage PREMAIN,CPYTHON_INITIALIZATION or TOP_LEVEL_IMPORT and a nonnull active group ordinal; no other token or cross-group state is legal. state bytes/hash recanonicalize and transition references match.
tasks_and_transitions.stop_world_epoch_rule: Every row has schema temporac.ptrace-stop-world-epoch.v7 and gap-free ordinal. Exactly one selector matches active_kind: RETURNING_TRANSITION uses active_transition_ordinal_or_null; TERMINAL_ENTRY uses active_terminal_entry_event_ordinal_or_null; FUTEX_COOPERATION uses futex_cooperation_ordinal_or_null. Ordinary pending priorities and exact peer-stop discriminants remain unchanged. FUTEX_COOPERATION is allocated at the equal-value WAIT ENTRY,initiator_task_ordinal equals wait_task and the row spans all four gates; no second waker/final epoch exists. Gate rows alone encode in-kernel versus held EXIT states. Both paired transitions and the cooperation select this epoch. resume_task_ordinals remains empty until both results,destinations,states,cursors and G3 validate atomically,then is the exact permitted sorted live set. Cross-epoch,orphan,reuse,early userspace or synthetic INFLIGHT state fails.
tasks_and_transitions.syscall_output_rule: A nonnull output is a closed temporac.ptrace-syscall-output.v2 object selected by the unique BASE fd_path_policy.syscall_output_contract_rows entry for syscall_name. destination_rows preserve the true destination-template/syscall/iovec order; each repeats the exact ENTRY pointer/capacity,records the exact prefix bytes written at EXIT and hashes those bytes. Top bytes is the exact sum,bytes_hex their ordered concatenation and sha256 its raw digest. kind,source_evidence_sha256 and source_offset_bytes_or_null equal the selected contract row and its closed replayed/static source; source_offset is nonnull only for FD_READ,DIRENT,DIRENT64. Every successful call with one or more output destinations,including zero-byte read/directory EOF,has a nonnull object. A contract-row conditional zero-destination branch and every syscall_output_none_names success use null and must prove no tracee-memory write. An error may use null only when the bound UAPI and contract row guarantee no write and ENTRY/EXIT proves every potential destination unchanged. Result,errno,destination count/order,output length,UAPI layout,kind,source,offset,hash or post-userspace mismatch fails.
tasks_and_transitions.syscall_output_source_rule: For REPLAYED_ARCH_STATE_BEFORE and REPLAYED_SIGNAL_STATE_BEFORE,the verifier deterministically replays the fixed initial task state and every prior accepted stateful transition into the exact closed source object and source_evidence_sha256 hashes its canonical bytes plus LF. CLONE_EVENT_TASK_IDENTITY hashes the exact closed clone identity source and byte-equals the task/event graph. CHILD_CREDENTIAL_STATE,CPU_REPLAY_PROFILE,DIRECTORY_PROJECTION,FD6_PHYSICAL_ENTRY_READBACK,FIXED_CWD_AUTHORITY,KERNEL_RUNTIME,RESOURCE_PROFILE,RESOLVED_PATH_METADATA,RESOLVED_SYMLINK_AUTHORITY,TRACKED_FD_METADATA and TRACKED_PROVIDER_BYTES select the already validated exact artifact/projection digest named. KERNEL_RUNTIME_NONAUTHORITY selects the accepted kernel-runtime digest but its observed clock/time bytes may never branch authority. BEFORE_OFD_OFFSET_OR_NULL_DEV_NULL is the before-OFD offset for a tracked seekable provider and null only for exact DEV_NULL EOF; other nonseekable reads reject; all other offset rules are literal. Missing source preimage,wrong prefix/task/artifact/offset or runtime-learned source fails.
tasks_and_transitions.task_row_rule: Tasks sort by gap-free task_ordinal and have unique positive kernel_tid/starttime pairs. Task0 has null parent/clone fields and its kernel_tid and starttime_ticks equal enclosing process.attach_evidence.child_pid and child_starttime_ticks. Every later task has a smaller parent ordinal and a nonnull unique CLONE event whose task/kernel identity cross-matches,whose event message equals its kernel_tid and whose paired CLONE_CHILD_STOP precedes first resume. Every ptrace event selecting any task repeats that task row kernel_tid. Every task has nonnull exit_event_ordinal_or_null equal its unique terminal row ptrace_exit_event_ordinal and selecting TASK_EXIT except the last live task,which selects PROCESS_EXIT. Attach,parent,clone,start,event,exit and terminal relations are bijective; orphan,duplicate,reused or contradictory kernel identity/ordinal fails. The per-task set_tid/robust-list state replay selects the same task identity and terminal-memory source; no task may register another task's clear-TID or a nonempty robust list.
tasks_and_transitions.terminal_memory_output_rule: Replay clone flags,set_tid_address and set_robust_list transitions per task into the exact terminal-memory source; its source_evidence_sha256 hashes canonical bytes plus LF. Every accepted robust head is read at ENTRY and every later stop and must be a bound ROBUST_LIST_HEAD layout with list.next equal to its own head,exact frozen futex_offset and list_op_pending null; thus it is empty and kernel exit performs no robust-owner write. A task with a nonnull final clear_tid pointer has exactly one CLEAR_CHILD_TID row sorted by pointer: the accepted nonexecutive writable PID_T destination contains that task kernel_tid in before_bytes_hex at the selected PTRACE_EVENT_EXIT stop; after the task is resumed only to final wait and before any peer resume,the same address contains four zero bytes. length_bytes=4 and schema/kind/source are exact. A task with null clear_tid has an empty array. Every task/cause,including exit_group followers and signal/controller-kill cleanup when retained,obeys the same rule. Missing/extra pointer,nonempty robust list,early peer resume,wrong before/after bytes or unmodeled terminal write fails.
tasks_and_transitions.terminal_syscall_rule: temporac.ptrace-terminal-syscall.v7 is the closed union over terminal_cause_values. SYSCALL_EXIT and SYSCALL_EXIT_GROUP have a nonnull TERMINAL_SYSCALL_ENTRY event,initiating task equal task_ordinal,null signal-delivery event,nonnull stop_world_epoch selecting an active TERMINAL_ENTRY epoch,exact one-key {status_u32} args+digest and exact exit/exit_group name+number; final_wait is WIFEXITED with status_u32 low8. SYSCALL_EXIT_GROUP is task0 and was the sole pending entry. EXIT_GROUP_FOLLOWER has null entry,args,name,number,signal event; initiating_task_ordinal selects the unique leader and stop_world_epoch byte-equals the leader epoch while final_wait byte-equals its wait. SIGNAL_TERMINATION has only a nonnull SIGNAL_DELIVERY event,all syscall/initiator/epoch fields null and WIFSIGNALED with the same signal. CONTROLLER_KILL has all entry/signal/syscall/initiator/epoch fields null and exact WIFSIGNALED/SIGKILL. Every row has one TASK_EXIT or PROCESS_EXIT ptrace event selected by ptrace_exit_event_ordinal; that message equals final_wait.raw_status_u32,has null signal/epoch and repeats this terminal object. state_sha256 is the current terminal address state. PASS has one leader exit_group(0),followers bind it,all waits are WIFEXITED/0 and outer wait is zero. No row fabricates a return,state,status,signal,cancellation or epoch. terminal_memory_outputs is the exact sorted clear-child-TID evidence governed by terminal_memory_output_rule and is captured after final wait before any surviving task resumes; it is not a returning syscall_output.
tasks_and_transitions.transition_rule: Every returning native syscall after state0 and before a terminal call has one strict temporac.kernel-syscall-transition.v9 row,including error,zero-effect and REVIEWED results. The policy row selects one closed args variant. ENTRY reserves identity and validates args,before FD/OFD/path/address/provider states,online prefix and the exact syscall-output contract or none row; ordinary PTRACE_SYSCALL then reaches EXIT. Before any userspace resume,EXIT captures result/errno,the complete contract-selected syscall_output_or_null,after states and ordered effects and atomically commits them. REJECT has no transition. Ordinary futex_cooperation_ordinal_or_null is null. A profiled pair has two consecutive rows with the same cooperation and whole-span epoch,effects empty,unchanged effect cursor,consecutive reserved FD/address states and one atomic G3 commit. Name,number,args,policy,group,epoch,cooperation,state,output-contract,output and cursor FKs are exact.

b5_kernel_transition_monitor.threat_boundary: The evidence closes Linux x86_64 kernel-visible executable mapping/permission consequences, including transient dlopen/dlmopen/dlclose effects and direct syscalls. It does not claim literal libdl API identity or defend against a malicious kernel, hypervisor or DMA. No unload, seccomp optimization, forked process, unreviewed pthread form, literal API interposer or epoch/quiescence exception is permitted by this amendment.

catalog_rules: action is exactly map,ignored-nonexecutive,or reject. emitter is one static provenance representative from CPYTHON,NATIVE_SUPERVISOR,INITIALIZATION,IMPORT,FINALIZATION and is never a runtime selector. action=map requires one preserved token; ignored/reject requires null. arg_projection_schema and definition digest satisfy the unique observable definition selected without emitter.

Rows serialize in total order by event_name,numeric arity,arg_projection_schema,static emitter,arg_projection_definition_sha256,action,mapped_token null-before-string,then canonical stage_set bytes. stage_set is a nonempty sorted unique subset of the exact child-only stage vocabulary. Static emitter is only a deterministic tie-breaker after observable-key uniqueness and never callback authority.

At the callback the observable definition key K=(event_name,positional arity,exact Python type vector) selects exactly one definition while ignoring emitter. The frozen state machine then selects exactly one expanded outcome by (K,current stage,action,mapped token),also ignoring emitter. Only after unique selection may the verifier read the row's static representative emitter and recompute the eight-key definition digest. Raw evidence supplies no emitter,site,PC,stage or outcome. Zero/multiple K definitions or outcomes,emitter-based selection,wildcard,prefix or runtime-learned row fails.

Every ignored-nonexecutive event/site/form is explicitly and exhaustively enumerated by the accepted source manifest and has a codec-fields definition bound to temporac.audit-args.ignored.v6. Ordinary artifact/data/receipt/index open or mmap is ignored only when that exact row says so and its bytes never become executable.

code.__new__,function.__new__,marshal or pickle code loading,sys.addaudithook after native installation,sys.settrace,sys.setprofile,subinterpreters,Python process spawning,executable anonymous memory and unexpected ctypes.dlsym or ctypes.call_function are explicit reject outcomes. Missing reject rows or converting reject to ignored/map fails.

Each catalog row references one definition; every definition has at least one row. Builder grouping across emitters guarantees exactly one definition for each observable K and unique expanded outcomes by K,stage,action,token. Compatible sites coalesce with the least-site-ordinal emitter as static representative; conflicting cross-emitter definitions/outcomes fail before candidate creation. Catalog/form/source sorts and all site provenance remain independently rederived.
catalog_extension.rule: All B6 consumers and schemas are materialized under the effective catalog. This Round8 object is a nonauthority mirror and supplies no runtime pointer.
catalog_extension.stage_token_vocabulary_rule: The materialized array byte-equals the exact pointer value, has 33 unique nonempty ASCII tokens in child execution order and hashes as canonical array+LF to stage_token_vocabulary_sha256. Every catalog stage_set is a nonempty ASCII-byte-sorted unique subset; no controller/local-overlay/safe-barrier prose token,alias or runtime-discovered stage is accepted.

codec_universe.forbidden: No codec may call repr, str conversion, hash, pickle, __fspath__, property, descriptor, iterator, user callback or ambient locale. No address, object id, randomized hash, filesystem normalization, wildcard, prefix match or sample-derived codec is permitted. Unsupported exact type/subclass fails.

Require type(x) is bytes; bytes is exact length and hex lowercase complete bytes.
Require type(x) is complex; encode exact IEEE-754 binary64 real/imag big-endian bit hex; nonfinite or negative-zero policy follows canonical numeric rules.

Require PyCode_CheckExact and the exact bound CPython3.12.13 object layout. Require the exact sys.meta_path list object at the frozen import safe barrier. Encode every element in order only through the closed provider_descriptor schema and precommitted provider arrays; no iterator, getattr callback, repr, identity address, omission or runtime-added provider is permitted.

Require the exact sys.path_hooks list object at the frozen import safe barrier. Encode every element in order only through the closed provider_descriptor schema and precommitted provider arrays; no iterator, getattr callback, repr, identity address, omission or runtime-added hook is permitted.
Require type(x) is float; encode exact IEEE-754 binary64 big-endian bit hex; reject nonfinite and forbidden negative zero.
Require exact frozenset; recursively encode through the definition fixed element codec, sort by complete canonical item bytes and reject duplicate canonical bytes.
Require type(x) is int, never bool; decimal is canonical signed base10 without leading zero or plus.
Require exact list; fixed recursively literal element codecs and preserve order; no iteration protocol beyond direct exact-list indexing.
Require x is None; encode only tag=null.

Require exact tuple; fixed recursively literal per-position codecs and preserve order.

codec_universe.rule: Rows are unique and sorted by codec then input_python_type UTF-8 bytes. Each generic codec with tag in output_shape must emit exactly tag_value_or_null; each CPython dedicated helper has null tag and no tag output. Exact type is required, with BOOL checked separately from INT; unsupported type/subclass or an unlisted codec fails. acceptance_binding_spec.rule: cas_root_profile_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the one complete P00-fixed temporac.stage-input-cas-root-profile.v6 canonical object+LF that is subsequently embedded byte-for-byte in the dispatch-table authority context. Before either P06 run,P00 publishes and revalidates the complete immutable builder and canonical source manifest under that profile; every P06 builder/manifest lookup is read-only and proves positive CAS_SIZE,complete read,EOF and rehash. After each child joins,the controller constructs the inline attestation and candidate outside the CAS and P00 publishes that exact candidate; independent review begins only after both candidate carriers revalidate under the same profile. candidate_carriers is exactly sorted ordinals0,1. Each row has positive bytes equal CAS_SIZE of its independently authorized lowercase sha256 after complete read+EOF+rehash; parsed schema is the candidate schema and outer run_ordinal equals candidate.run_ordinal and embedded attestation.run_ordinal. Attestation digest/preimage/FKs validate and the two PID/starttime pairs differ. Raw candidate digests and attestations differ,but after deleting exactly run_ordinal,run_attestation and run_attestation_sha256 the candidates are byte-identical. status=ACCEPT is valid only after independent fresh review binds both carriers,builder,manifest,registry,payload and exact CAS profile. These P00 publication epochs are operations of the existing authorized writer,not new dispatch owners,receipts or DAG edges. No authority exists before this binding.

builder_artifact_spec.rule: builder_bytes and builder_sha256 identify the complete immutable builder source named by the source manifest. Before either P06 run,P00 publishes and revalidates that builder under the fixed CAS root profile whose digest is later copied byte-identically into the acceptance binding. Each P06 resolves it only by read-only CAS lookup; builder_bytes is positive and equals CAS_SIZE after complete read+EOF+rehash. Hash,count,source,profile,publication-order mismatch or alternate entrypoint fails.

candidate_spec.rule: After each P06 builder child joins,the nonauthority controller constructs this complete candidate outside the CAS. run_attestation has exactly the accepted attestation schema,rehashes to run_attestation_sha256 and matches candidate run ordinal,builder,manifest,registry and payload digests. catalog_payload is the final v8 catalog after deleting only argument_definition_provenance,argument_definition_provenance_sha256 and schema; bytes/hex/hash cover that exact eight-key canonical projection. registry_sha256 resolves the complete v7 registry. Candidate output cannot name the later acceptance binding or final catalog hash. P00 validates and publishes the exact candidate under the pre-fixed profile only after its corresponding joined run; independent review cannot select that carrier before publication and complete revalidation. P06 never writes the stage CAS.

definition_builder.cas_profile_binding_rule: Before either P06 run,P00 fixes one complete CAS root profile,acquires the existing root-inode authorized-writer lock,and publishes the exact immutable builder and canonical source manifest with the authorized P00 publication algorithm. P00 closes,reopens and completely validates both objects; only then may either P06 start. Each P06 resolves those same independently authorized digests through read-only CAS lookup and proves positive CAS_SIZE,complete read,EOF and SHA-256 before executing; it emits result bytes outside the CAS and never obtains a CAS writer FD. After each P06 child joins and the controller constructs its typed inline attestation and candidate,P00 validates that candidate and attestation,reacquires the same lock and publishes that exact candidate. Independent review starts only after both candidate publications complete and rehash. The later dispatch context embeds the byte-identical profile and digest. These pre-run and post-run P00 publication epochs add no dispatch owner,receipt or DAG edge. P06 is never an authorized CAS writer; no alternate root or profile handoff exists.
construction_order: Before either run P00 publishes the immutable builder and source manifest. Each P06 statically scans all bound source sites,groups them by observable K=(event_name,arity,exact type vector) across emitter values,and proves exhaustive site/source/span provenance without observed-event discovery.

For each K coalesce cross-emitter sites only when all seven non-emitter definition fields and all expanded stage/action/token outcomes are byte-identical and nonconflicting. Serialize emitter from the least numeric site_ordinal as static provenance; conflicting sites fail before candidate creation. Fresh observations only compare bytes and never choose an emitter/form.
Resolve only the closed codec universe or four dedicated projection rows; any unsupported exact type/form requires a new reviewed amendment and fails closed.

For run_ordinal0 and run_ordinal1,one fresh P06 child uses only the prepublished read-only inputs to construct the complete registry and eight-key catalog payload,canonicalize/hash and exit; the controller joins it and constructs the typed attestation and candidate outside the CAS. P00 validates and publishes that exact candidate under the pre-fixed profile and existing authorized-writer lock only after the corresponding run. Only after both published carriers revalidate and normalize byte-identically may the independent acceptance binding populate final provenance/catalog and BASE.

run_attestation_spec.digest_rule: run_attestation_sha256 is SHA-256 of the complete standalone eleven-key canonical attestation plus LF and is absent from that object.
run_attestation_spec.rule: The nonauthority preflight controller constructs this object only after one fresh child process terminates. run_ordinal is0 or1; child_pid and starttime are positive and the pair differs across runs; exit_code=0,wait_status_u32=0,status=JOINED_PASS. Builder,manifest,registry and catalog-payload digests exactly equal the enclosing candidate values. It contains no candidate digest or candidate bytes, so the edge run inputs/results -> attestation -> candidate is acyclic. Missing wait,process reuse,digest mismatch or fabricated freshness fails.

source_manifest_spec.digest_binding_rule: Rows are in exact field order codec,dedicated,ignored,import plan and have exactly digest_binding_row_closed_keys. The first three manifest fields equal their nonnull literal expected_static_sha256_or_null and a fresh canonical-LF hash of the exact local pointer value. import_plan_sha256 is nonnull in the actual manifest and equals the existing BASE role future artifact digest under that pointer digest_rule; its expected_static value is null only because its complete reviewed rows are future-populated before BASE, not runtime-learned. source_manifest_spec.form_definition_digest_rule: Every form row definition is an exact closed eight-key definition. definition_sha256 is SHA-256 of that standalone canonical definition bytes plus LF; it must select the byte-identical unique final registry definition and every catalog_outcome must select a catalog row carrying the same digest. source_manifest_spec.observable_key_rule: Group every source site by K=(event_name,arity,exact python_type_vector) across emitter values. A group yields exactly one form only when its seven non-emitter definition fields and complete expanded outcomes are byte-identical/nonconflicting. The form definition.emitter equals the emitter of the least numeric site_ordinal in that group; site_ordinals retain the complete emitter set. Runtime never uses that representative. Conflict,second definition for K or outcome collision fails.
source_manifest_spec.outcome_sort_rule: Within each form, catalog_outcomes is nonempty,duplicate-free and totally sorted by action UTF-8 bytes,mapped_token_or_null with null before string,then complete canonical stage_set array bytes. Every stage_set obeys the exact catalog stage vocabulary. The expanded (definition digest,stage,action,token) keys are unique across all forms. Expanded uniqueness is keyed by observable K,stage,action,token across all emitter metadata.
source_manifest_spec.rule: source_rows are the complete accepted CPython3.12.13/native supervisor/initialization/import/finalization emitter sources and sole builder source. Every source path is unique; source_rows are strictly sorted by complete path UTF-8 bytes; bytes equals the exact complete byte length at that accepted path and sha256 hashes those exact complete bytes. site_rows are strictly sorted by numeric site_ordinal,whose values are unique,zero-based and gap-free. Every site source_path selects exactly one source row and source_sha256 equals that row sha256; each span is half-open with 0<=span_start_byte<span_end_byte<=source.bytes and span_sha256 hashes exactly source_bytes[span_start_byte:span_end_byte]. Every literal emit site appears exactly once. form_rows are strictly sorted by numeric form_ordinal,whose values are unique,zero-based and gap-free. Each site_ordinals array is numeric-ascending and duplicate-free,every value selects exactly one site row,and the multiset union of all form site_ordinals is an exact no-omission,no-duplication partition of every site_ordinal. Form rows contain complete definitions/outcomes and are derived solely from those sites and the fixed import plan; observations cannot widen them. All four top digest fields obey digest_binding_rows,and every form definition/hash/catalog FK obeys form_definition_digest_rule. Form grouping and representative emitter obey observable_key_rule; an emitter is never inferred from a runtime callback.

definition_provenance.rule: The final value embeds the exact accepted binding,builder and source manifest and their standalone hashes. All three recanonicalize and cross-match; the binding accepts two complete candidate carriers. No candidate or observation is authority, and no builder/manifest/binding field is selected during an authority run.

definition_registry.codec_spec_rule: Every codec-fields field row contains one recursively closed temporac.audit-codec-spec.v6.
